channel.description: Latest Microsoft 365 Message Center messages and Microsoft 365 Roadmap posts from message.cengizyilmaz.net. Message Center posts vary by tenant; always use your tenant's Message Center as the source of truth.

item.title: MC1442716: Updates available for Microsoft 365 Apps for Current Channel
item.description: We've released updates to the following update channel for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out this update of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on that update channel starting July 29th, 2026 (PST). How this will affect your organization: If your Microsoft 365 Apps clients are configured to automatically update from the Office Content Delivery Network (CDN), then no action is required. If you manage updates directly you can now download this latest...

item.title: MC1442614: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced IntelliFrame with AI data channel for intelligent cameras
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will gain enhanced IntelliFrame AI features via certified intelligent cameras, enabling faster speaker framing, participant recognition, and smoother views. AI processing occurs on-device with metadata sent through a dedicated channel, improving performance especially in low bandwidth. Rollout is mid-September to mid-October 2026, enabled by default with no admin action needed.

item.title: MC1442612: Microsoft PowerPoint: Access your organization's brand templates in PowerPoint
item.description: Microsoft PowerPoint will enable users with Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) on Windows to access organizational brand templates directly from Backstage starting August 2026. Organizations must configure Brand kits and designate brand managers to publish templates, ensuring consistent branding without removing existing Organizational Asset Library templates.

item.title: RM392328: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars
item.description: Organizers, co-organizers, and presenters can chat privately in a separate chat from attendees. This chat is available to access before, during, and after the event.

item.title: RM410366: Microsoft Teams: User uploaded custom background images for the new VDI solution for Microsoft Teams
item.description: With this new feature, users on the new VDI solution for Teams can blur their background, choose a Teams virtual background, or replace their background entirely with any image they want by uploading it through the "Video effects and Settings" option.

item.title: RM557165: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars on Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: When a Teams Rooms on Windows acts as an organizer, co-organizer or presenter in a structured meeting or webinar, you have access to the private chat for event management known as the Event Group. You can also switch to a separate chat with attendees enabling smooth event experiences for all. Available in Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms.

item.title: RM560318: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: In addition to capturing real-time notes and meeting outcomes during scheduled or hybrid meetings, the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Windows. Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console. Meeting notes appear on the front of room display or touch board, are available via meeting recap when shared, and deleted if no one selected. Rest assured no data remains in the room. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

item.title: RM560700: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: In addition to capturing real-time notes and meeting outcomes during scheduled or hybrid meetings, the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Android. Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console. Meeting notes appear on the front of room display or touch board, are available via meeting recap when shared, and deleted if no one selected. Rest assured no data remains in the room. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

item.title: RM561892: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard prompts for government clouds
item.description: We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard prompts containing sensitive data. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data leakage and oversharing risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from returning a response when prompts contain sensitive data or using that sensitive data for grounding in Microsoft 365 or the web.

item.title: RM561914: Microsoft Teams: Mandatory pre-meeting consent
item.description: We are providing a new configuration experience in Teams Admin Center where tenant admins can enable and customize an explicit consent message before joining any meeting hosted in their organization.

item.title: RM562354: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Updated Copilot Answers
item.description: Copilot Answers in Copilot Search (in the M365 Copilot App on web and desktop) will provide more concise responses and more prominently highlight the ability to continue in the conversation in Copilot chat on the right-hand sidebar.

item.title: RM564969: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced IntelliFrame with AI data channel for intelligent cameras
item.description: Teams Rooms on Windows users can now benefit from next generation IntelliFrame features on certified AI-capable cameras with on-device video processing. With IntelliFrame’s expanded AI data channel, participants experience faster active speaker framing, people recognition and labels, and more responsive meeting views—even when network conditions are limited. These capabilities are available with Teams Rooms Pro.

item.title: RM565870: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Data Loss Prevention to safeguard sensitive information from external web search in Microsoft 356 Copilot and Copilot Chat
item.description: We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard web searches containing sensitive data. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data leakage and oversharing risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data for external web search.

item.title: RM566864: Microsoft Edge: Ask Copilot about an image
item.description: Ask Copilot about an image in Edge enables users to instantly analyze images from the web by sending them directly to Copilot from the Edge context menu, making it easy to ask questions, gain insights, and understand visual content without leaving their browsing experience. Admins can control availability to this feature using the EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext and Microsoft365CopilotChatIconEnabled policies.

item.title: RM567887: SharePoint: Viva Connections multi-home site management moving to SharePoint admin center
item.description: Viva Connections multi-home site management is moving from the Microsoft 365 admin center (MAC) to the SharePoint Admin Center (SPAC). Administrators will be able to create and manage multiple Home sites, configure audience targeting, manage home site priority order, and remove Home sites directly from SPAC. Existing entry points in the Microsoft 365 admin center will direct administrators to the new SPAC experience. As part of this update, legacy Viva Connections (VC) instances and draft/enable...

item.title: RM567890: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Auto-labeling scale increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
item.description: We are increasing the maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive from 100,000 up to 500,000 files per tenant per day. This helps organizations label and protect more of their data at rest, faster, closing labeling gaps across existing content. With sensitivity labels and protection settings applied to more files sooner, organizations can better prepare their data estate for Microsoft 365 Copilot with greater confidence.

item.title: RM568072: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Dashboard - Targeted Audience Surveys
item.description: Targeted Audience Surveys let change leaders launch a Copilot Pulse survey directly from the Copilot Dashboard to all licensed or active users. Audiences update automatically using Insights data and respect existing dashboard filters like organization and job function, with privacy protected through population-level reporting only. Pair adoption metrics with employee sentiment in just a few clicks.

item.title: RM568364: Microsoft Viva: Rolling out Custom branding in Engage
item.description: Engage is rolling out Custom Branding, a new admin-led capability that lets organizations define a customized, tenant-wide visual identity across the Engage web and mobile apps. Engage-level admins can configure a brand name, add large and small logos, and a theme color that is applied consistently for all users in the tenant. Branding is managed from the new Brand Center in the Viva Engage admin center and helps organizations reinforce their identity throughout the Engage experience.

item.title: RM568365: Microsoft Edge: Import Google account data anytime from Settings
item.description: Microsoft Edge now lets users import their Google account data - including passwords, bookmarks, history, and autofill data - directly from Edge Settings, at any time after setup. Previously, users had no way to import this data from a Google account outside the first-run experience. With this update, the import flow is unified into a single, streamlined entry point in Settings that combines import from Google Chrome import and Google account.

item.title: MC1442609: Microsoft Teams: Teams shared display mode and peripheral detection for BYOD spaces
item.description: Microsoft Teams is introducing shared display mode and enhanced peripheral detection for BYOD meeting spaces to improve meeting join experience and privacy. Rollout begins late July 2026. Administrators gain new reporting and device health insights in Teams Pro Management portal, with options to opt out of data collection. Users can disable automatic meeting room mode.

item.title: MC1442608: Microsoft SharePoint Embedded: Update to driveItem.webUrl behavior
item.description: Microsoft is updating SharePoint Embedded's driveItem.webUrl to return browser launch URLs instead of stable file locations. Use driveItemId for stable identifiers. Changes roll out from mid-August 2026, with a temporary opt-out until February 22, 2027. Review and update applications accordingly.

item.title: MC1403403: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: View-only role management enhancements
item.description: Microsoft Purview now allows Global Reader and Security Reader roles to view role assignments and scopes in Purview and Defender portals with read-only access, enhancing compliance transparency without changing permissions. This feature rolls out globally from late August to September 2026 and requires no user action.

item.title: MC1438566: Action Required: Defer Upgrade to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint on Linux Build 101.26052.0009
item.description: The upgrade to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint on Linux build 101.26052.0009 for FIPS-enabled RHEL 8 and 9 devices has been paused due to issues. The message is now outdated and can be disregarded. No action is needed if already upgraded without problems.

item.title: MC1405505: Access your brand assets in PowerPoint
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint will provide native access to brand assets (colors, logos, icons, images) via a dedicated brand pane starting mid-July 2026. Licensed users can create or use official brand kits for on-brand presentations, with admins able to manage branding centrally. No action is needed for default use.

item.title: MC1388706: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Legal agent available in Frontier worldwide
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot's Legal agent in Word, designed for legal professionals to review and negotiate contracts, is now in Public Preview worldwide for Frontier users starting mid-June 2026, with general availability in mid-August. It uses AI to analyze documents, generate redlines, and compare clauses without separate installation.

item.title: MC1245225: Microsoft Teams: Ad-hoc room reservation from Teams Rooms on Windows console
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will support ad-hoc room reservations directly from the console, requiring a Teams Rooms Pro license. Rollout is from July to September 2026, varying by region. The feature is enabled by default, with admin controls available, and no action is needed before rollout.

item.title: MC1188222: Microsoft Teams: Private chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings, webinars, and town halls
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a private chat for organizers, co-organizers, and presenters in structured meetings, webinars, and town halls, unifying backroom chat behavior. Rollout begins late September 2026, completing by early November. Admins should review policies, communicate changes, and update documentation accordingly.

item.title: MC1393808: Microsoft Teams: Experience improvements to Voice apps configuration wizard in Teams admin center
item.description: Microsoft is updating the Auto Attendant and Call Queue configuration wizard in the Teams admin center to streamline setup, improve navigation, and enhance performance. Rollout began June 2026 globally, with GCC High and DoD starting late July. No action is required; existing settings remain unchanged.

item.title: MC1307512: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Microsoft Teams is expanding AI-powered meeting notes with the Facilitator agent to Teams Rooms on Windows for in-person meetings. Rolling out from September to November 2026, notes are captured live, stored securely in tenant-owned SharePoint, and accessible via meeting recap. Licensing and settings prerequisites apply.

item.title: MC1307888: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams is expanding AI-powered meeting notes with the Facilitator agent to Teams Rooms on Android, enabling real-time note-taking during in-person meetings. Notes are securely stored in tenant-owned SharePoint and accessible via meeting recap. Rollout begins early September 2026, requiring Teams Rooms Pro licensing and specific tenant settings.

item.title: MC1387814: Microsoft Teams: RTMP-In port and domain changes required
item.description: Microsoft Teams is updating RTMP-In port and domain requirements to improve streaming reliability. Admins must allow outbound access to ports 50118, 50119, and domain *.rtmpingest.mcr.teams.cloud.microsoft by January 31, 2027. Existing RTMP-In events work until December 31, 2026. The feature release is currently paused.

item.title: MC1281505: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management- Azure PST Import
item.description: Azure PST Import enables Microsoft 365 admins to import PST files from Azure Blob Storage into Exchange Online mailboxes using PowerShell. It includes readiness validation, reporting, and compliance controls. Rollout begins mid-September 2026 (public preview) and late October 2026 (worldwide). No GUI; admin-driven process.

item.title: MC1269864: Microsoft Teams: New chat sections for muted and meeting chats
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce two new chat sections—Muted chats (enabled by default) and Meeting chats (disabled by default)—to organize chats. Rollout starts mid-August 2026, completing by end of September. Users can enable/disable and reorder these sections; no admin action or controls are required.

item.title: MC1117115: Updates to custom scripting in sites and Classic Publishing site creation
item.description: Starting September 15, 2025, SharePoint Online will disable custom scripting by default on classic publishing sites, block creation of new classic publishing sites, and prevent publishing feature activation. New settings allow site property bag updates without enabling custom scripting. Temporary opt-outs via PowerShell are available until March 15, 2026.

item.title: MC1418559: Action required: Retirement of EWS-based Personal Bookings controls (Microsoft Bookings)
item.description: Microsoft is retiring EWS-based controls for Personal Bookings in Microsoft Bookings on August 5, 2026. After that, access will be managed only via OWA Mailbox Policy settings. Administrators must migrate existing EWS configurations to OWA policies before this date to maintain control.

item.title: MC1413299: Custom templates in Microsoft Planner
item.description: Microsoft Planner will introduce custom templates in July 2026, enabling users to convert plans into reusable templates shared within Microsoft 365 Groups. This standardizes workflows, improves consistency, and accelerates project creation. Templates include tasks and details, reset progress when reused, and require no admin setup.

item.title: MC1442135: Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Orchestrate conversation distribution with AI-powered playbooks
item.description: We are announcing the ability to orchestrate conversation distribution with AI-powered playbooks in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on August 28, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature actively monitors conversations and automatically takes actions based on playbooks defined using natural language. You can configure playbooks per scenario through guided templates that keep instructions focused and reliable. Built-in validation catches conflicts befo...

item.title: MC1441784: Microsoft Copilot for Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
item.description: Microsoft is updating the Copilot entry point in classic Outlook to a new location next to the ribbon, offering AI-powered, contextual recommendations. This change, rolling out worldwide from late August to October 2026, requires no action but should be communicated to users and support teams.

item.title: MC1441782: Upload or add a custom skill with Copilot in PowerPoint (Web)
item.description: PowerPoint Copilot users can upload and create personal custom skills directly within PowerPoint (Web), stored in their OneDrive for tailored use. This feature, rolling out worldwide from late July to early August 2026, requires no admin action but may need internal process updates.

item.title: MC1441781: Add and upload your custom skills to OneDrive from within PowerPoint Copilot (Mac)
item.description: PowerPoint Copilot on Mac will let users create, upload, and manage personal custom skills directly within the app, saving them to their OneDrive for personal use. This feature rolls out worldwide from late July to early August 2026, requiring no immediate admin action.

item.title: MC1441775: Microsoft Whiteboard: Retirement of legacy whiteboards and transition to OneDrive-backed whiteboards
item.description: Microsoft Whiteboard is retiring legacy whiteboards and the standalone app by September 2026. Enterprise users must migrate legacy whiteboards to OneDrive-backed versions before August 22, 2026. After September 5, legacy whiteboards will be deleted permanently, and the standalone app will be deprecated by September 14.

item.title: MC1441774: Microsoft Teams: Meeting Participant Detail audit records will be available in all participating (non-organizer) tenants
item.description: Starting late August 2026, Microsoft Teams will share Meeting Participant Detail audit records with all participating tenants for their own users in cross-tenant meetings, enhancing audit visibility while maintaining data boundaries. No action is required, but admins may review audit processes accordingly.

item.title: MC1441773: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Unified data access messages in Microsoft 365 Copilot
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot now shows a consistent message when Microsoft Purview DLP policies restrict content access or processing. This update improves transparency by standardizing notifications across Copilot experiences, requiring no user action, and rolling out worldwide by July 2026. Administrators should update guidance accordingly.

item.title: MC1441767: Follow up to IT1431577: Recommended update KB5101684 Preview for Windows devices
item.description: The message recommends installing the Windows cumulative update KB5101684 Preview to fully remediate the issue from IT1431577. This update provides a client fix and platform improvements. Organizations should deploy this update following their usual update and validation procedures.

item.title: RM380842: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Referenced sources are cited in drafted content
item.description: When drafting content using the inline canvas Copilot experience that's based on referenced sources, Copilot includes citations in the text it generates, indicating references to information in the content.

item.title: RM394279: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention - Decoupling of Policy tips and Email notifications while configuring rules on Data Loss Prevention for Sharepoint and Onedrive
item.description: As of today, whenever the user wants to enable email notifications the policy tips also need to be enabled and vice versa, but with this decoupling the admin can configure the following: 1) None of policy tips or email notification 2) Only policy tips 3) Only Email Notifications 4) Both Email Notifications and Policy tips

item.title: RM479965: OneDrive: Upcoming change to shared folder experience in Microsoft OneDrive
item.description: With this feature update, when a user clicks a link to a shared folder from Teams chat, channels, email, or other places, they will navigate to the shared folder within the People view of their own OneDrive. This new view, organized by people, will show and allow access to all the files and folders that have been shared with the user.

item.title: RM494999: Microsoft 365: M365 Archive Search
item.description: M365 Archive will introduce new search capabilities that allow end-users to easily identify archived content. This feature aims to improve productivity by making archived data searchable by end users so they can identify which site needs to be reactivated.

item.title: RM497844: Microsoft CoPilot (Microsoft 365): Makers can build DA's with Flexible layouts and rich UX components
item.description: Flexible layouts and rich UX components will enable makers to build highly expressive agents, ultimately driving increased user engagement and virality.

item.title: RM498923: Viva Glint - Action Taking Report (Public Preview)
item.description: Introduction of a new report that provides transparency into platform activity by dashboard users. Metrics such as report views, Team Conversations completed, Focus Areas created, and more will be visible and filterable with this report.

item.title: RM500242: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent recap for DoD
item.description: Intelligent meeting recap uses AI to provide a quick summary of your meeting, highlighting key discussion points, identifying follow-up actions, and offering quick access to significant points such as name mentions, when a screen was shared, individualized speaker markers, topics, and chapters.

item.title: RM501111: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users in GCC-M will able to use custom engine agents
item.description: Users in GCC-M will be able to use custom engine agents.

item.title: RM502520: Microsoft Teams: New sharing panel in meetings - improved content discovery and ease of sharing
item.description: The sharing panel in today’s meetings is the default place for content discoverability and sharing. New sharing panel UI is crafted with intent of modernising and simplifying default tasks such as window sharing, but also for easier discovery of sharing options and more discoverable file sharing.

item.title: RM513274: Microsoft Viva: Engage Communities in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Your Viva Engage communities will now be available in Teams along side teams, chats and channels. Engage communities in Microsoft Teams make it simple to connect, share, and learn across your organization. This new experience brings discoverable, asynchronous conversations and leadership engagement into Teams—helping employees explore ideas and perspectives beyond project-based collaboration.

item.title: RM515145: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Workforce Insights Agent
item.description: Workforce Insights (WFI) Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot is an agent designed to help leaders, managers, and their delegates quickly understand their organization by turning complex workforce data into clear, actionable insights. With WFI Agent, leaders can quickly explore their organization’s structure, team composition, skills inventories, and flexible work patterns to move from insight to action in a single, unified experience directly in Copilot or Teams.

item.title: RM543713: Microsoft Teams: Call quality feedback surveys for Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Users can now rate the quality of their calls and meetings and provide additional feedback on calling, video, and screen-sharing experiences to help organizations ensure consistent, high-quality experiences.

item.title: RM548648: Microsoft Teams: Ad-hoc room reservation from Teams Rooms on Windows console
item.description: With Teams Rooms on Windows consoles, you can quickly book a meeting room for immediate use, helping to avoid scheduling conflicts and ensure uninterrupted spontaneous meetings. Available in Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms.

item.title: RM553224: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Enhanced Topic Assignment
item.description: We're upgrading our topic assignment pipeline to be powered by Copilot, delivering significantly improved accuracy in categorizing survey comments into relevant topics.

item.title: RM555858: Microsoft Teams: Admin setting for simpler meeting passcodes (numeric‑only)
item.description: Tenant admins can enable a meeting policy setting that generates 8 digit numeric-only passcodes for meetings organized by selected users/groups. Because numeric-only passcodes increase the risk of unauthorized access, enabling the setting displays a warning and requires explicit confirmation.

item.title: RM557559: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management- Azure PST Import
item.description: Azure PST Import is a migration method that enables PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage to be imported directly into Exchange Online mailboxes. It follows the standard two‑step Exchange Migration Service pattern: an initial analysis phase to validate and assess PST data, followed by execution of the actual migration. The process also involves creating a migration endpoint, running an analysis-only migration batch, using the analysis results to configure the final batch, and then starting the...

item.title: RM557676: Outlook: Delimiter setting admin policy
item.description: Admins will be able to define a tenant‑wide default value for the Mail Compose and Reply setting that controls whether commas are used to separate recipients. Updated June 2, 2026: We are in the process of correcting an issue with setting the policy. We expect to complete in mid-June. Thank you for your patience.

item.title: RM557683: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management- Data Security Triage Agent in IRM Enhancements
item.description: The Data Security Triage Agent in Insider Risk Management is deploying enhancements such as improved user risk and activity explorer pattern summaries to support improved investigation accuracy, context, and decision quality.

item.title: RM558286: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent meeting recap available without saving transcript
item.description: Intelligent recap can now be generated without retaining a transcript after the meeting. Meeting organizers can choose this setting from the meeting options before the meeting, or organizers and eligible participants can enable it during the meeting. After the meeting, the AI Summary will be available, but other elements of the recap may not be available (Chapters, Topics, Mentions, Audio recap).

item.title: RM558341: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator detects and answers questions
item.description: Facilitator now automatically detects open questions raised during a Teams meeting and offers to help answer them using web search. When a participant asks a question (e.g., “What is an LLM?”) and no one answers, Facilitator posts a prompt offering to find an answer. Participants can select “Yes” to have the agent retrieve and share the information.

item.title: RM558343: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management– Hard delete capability for OneDrive and SharePoint through secure priority cleanup workflows
item.description: Data Lifecycle Management allows compliance admins to retain, review and delete content in M365 workloads. Deletion of content to adhere to compliance requirements, admins can set up Retention policies or labels. To help prevent inadvertent data loss, M365 retention labels policies and M365 retention policies do not hard delete content immediately and keeps the data in Recycle Bins for 93 days for ODSP. Hard delete itself is a very costly process as it opens Microsoft to heavy legal implications...

item.title: RM559106: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - DLP Policy Change Insights with Security Copilot
item.description: Introduce an AI-powered capability leveraging Microsoft Security Copilot to automatically generate natural language explanations of changes made to DLP policies after each update within Microsoft Purview. This feature will analyze policy version deltas (pre-update vs. post-update) and produce a structured, human-readable summary that clearly explains: What changed Where the change occurred (rule, condition, action, location, etc.) The impact of the change The potential enforcement implications T...

item.title: RM559482: Microsoft Viva: Recent feed in Viva Engage
item.description: Introducing a new “Recent” feed in Home to give users a more predictable view of followed and priority communications, while preserving the existing personalized “For you” experience.

item.title: RM559617: Microsoft Purview: Purview in Microsoft Admin Center
item.description: AI and IT admins in Microsoft Admin Center can 1) gain visibility around oversharing risks and drive remediations 2) Understand how much of sensitive copilot interactions are protected and turn on Purview DLP for M365 Copilot right from there. Enables secure adoption of Copilot.

item.title: RM559996: Microsoft Viva: New Overview experience in Agent Dashboard
item.description: Customers can now view and understand their agent landscape through the new Overview page that will be included as part of the Agent Dashboard in Microsoft Viva. This experience will provide customers with key at-a-glance insights on adoption in their organizations and visibility into who’s creating agents used in their organization.

item.title: RM560600: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Policy Recommendation Panel in IRM
item.description: Today, Insider Risk Management (IRM) provides policy-driven protection for data leaks, data theft, and risky AI usage. However, while policy-driven protections are powerful, customers may not always have clear visibility into where coverage can be optimized or expanded to address latent insider risk.

item.title: RM560708: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection – AI-powered intent for classifiers
item.description: AI-powered intent for classifiers: Microsoft Purview Information Protection will generate a human-readable semantic intent for custom Sensitive Information Types (SITs), helping customers better understand what their classifiers detect and refine them for higher accuracy and fewer false positives.

item.title: RM560820: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Increase in expansion limit for auto expanding archive beyond 1.5TB
item.description: Previously, auto expanding archive mailbox expansion was supported only up to 1.5 TB, after which mailboxes would become inoperative. Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the 1.5 TB limit, ensuring uninterrupted retention and enabling scalable archive growth as storage thresholds are reached. This capability to expand archive beyond 1.5 TB will be available to customers with eligible E5 licenses.

item.title: RM561034: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Hard delete capability for OneDrive and SharePoint through secure priority cleanup workflows
item.description: Data Lifecycle Management allows compliance admins to retain, review and delete content in M365 workloads. Deletion of content to adhere to compliance requirements, admins can set up Retention policies or labels. To help prevent inadvertent data loss, M365 retention labels policies and M365 retention policies do not hard delete content immediately and keeps the data in Recycle Bins for 93 days for ODSP. Hard delete itself is a very costly process as it opens Microsoft to heavy legal implications...

item.title: RM561206: Microsoft 365 admin center: New dedicated License Requests page in Microsoft 365 Admin Center
item.description: We are introducing a new dedicated License Requests page in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center to help admins more easily discover, review, and manage Microsoft 365 Copilot license requests submitted by users.

item.title: RM561208: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Archive OneDrive and SharePoint files under retention
item.description: With the introduction of file archiving support in SharePoint Online, administrators are looking to seamlessly include archiving actions within their existing data retention policies. This means that, in addition to keeping or deleting data, admins want to now leverage Purview DLM to archive files according to organizational requirements, ensuring comprehensive governance across all stages of the content lifecycle in SPO. Retention based file archiving moves inactive content to low-cost storage,...

item.title: RM562051: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Enriched Audit Data for Matched Rules
item.description: When DLP rules detect policy violations in Exchange Online, they generate audit records that administrators rely on for compliance monitoring, incident investigation, and policy tuning. Previously, these records only showed Sensitive Information Type matches. This feature aims to extend that to sender domain, subject keywords, attachment type, or recipient information. Now they will be visible in alerts and Activity Explorer providing data enrichment to the administrators.

item.title: RM562341: Microsoft Teams: Join Google Meet meetings in Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Organizations now have expanded meeting interoperability with two-way Direct Guest Join (DGJ) between Google Meet and Teams meetings. Teams Rooms on Windows devices can join Google Meet meetings, and Google Meet devices can join Teams meetings. Users can join with one click through the calendar or by meeting ID. This capability is now available for both Commercial (Feb 2026) and Government cloud environments.

item.title: RM562345: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Archive OneDrive and SharePoint files under retention
item.description: With the introduction of file archiving support in SharePoint Online, administrators are looking to seamlessly include archiving actions within their existing data retention policies. This means that, in addition to keeping or deleting data, admins want to now leverage Purview DLM to archive files according to organizational requirements, ensuring comprehensive governance across all stages of the content lifecycle in SPO. Retention based file archiving moves inactive content to low-cost storage,...

item.title: RM564608: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Support for MCP Agents with Interactive UI Widgets in Government Clouds
item.description: Feature description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) based agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat will now be able to surface rich, interactive UI widgets directly within chat. This enhancement enables developers to deliver more engaging and structured agent interactions. Users will experience these widgets when interacting with agents that implement them, and admins will continue to manage these agents through the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

item.title: RM564766: Microsoft Teams: Manage Built-in Teams agents in the Teams admin center
item.description: Admins will be able to manage Teams built-in agents across core Teams experiences, including chats, channels, and meetings, through a dedicated experience in the Teams admin center. From a centralized location, admins can control agents’ availability for users and groups. These agents will be enabled by default for licensed users and managed independently from org-wide Microsoft app settings.

item.title: RM564910: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Outlook Emails in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Outlook Emails as References in Copilot Notebooks bring email content into the notebook experience, enabling users to ground Copilot in the conversations, decisions, and context that drive their work.

item.title: RM565865: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Azure PST Import

item.description: Microsoft Teams will detect and label external meeting assistant bots attempting to join meetings, giving organizers control to approve, deny, or remove them. This feature, rolling out mid-2026, includes new admin policies for managing bots and aims to enhance meeting security and compliance.

item.title: MC1045221: Microsoft Teams: New user setting to view incoming calls in a small window
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a new default setting allowing users to view incoming calls in a small, resizable window, reducing disruption. Rollout begins May 2025 (Targeted Release) and completes by August 2026 (GCC High, DoD). No admin action is needed; user notification is recommended.

item.title: MC1258000: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – analyze files tied to endpoint DLP alerts
item.description: Microsoft Purview’s Data Security Investigations now includes endpoint DLP events as a queryable source, enabling admins to analyze related files automatically. Rollout begins June 2026 (preview) and August 2026 (general availability). No user impact; admins can prepare by reviewing and updating workflows accordingly.

item.title: MC1288527: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – File Quarantine action for SharePoint and OneDrive
item.description: Microsoft Purview DLP introduces a File Quarantine action for SharePoint and OneDrive, isolating files that violate policies in an admin-controlled site with a tombstone file replacing the original. Rolling out from mid-April to July 2026, it requires admin configuration and manual file restoration.

item.title: MC1423103: Copilot Notebooks now supports Markdown (.md) files as grounding sources
item.description: Copilot Notebooks now support Markdown (.md) files as reference sources, enabling grounding in technical docs without conversion. This feature, rolling out worldwide by early August 2026, requires no admin setup, respects existing permissions, and enhances Copilot’s response relevance using Markdown content. No user action is needed.

item.title: MC796790: M365 and Microsoft Teams: Unified management of app and agent availability in Teams, Outlook, and the Microsoft 365 app
item.description: Microsoft is unifying app and agent availability management across Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 admin centers to ensure consistent settings. The rollout starts September 2025 and completes by September 2026 in phases, enabling synchronized management and installation of apps from either admin center.

item.title: MC1387573: Microsoft Teams: Governance for built-in agents in the Teams admin center
item.description: Microsoft Teams now offers a dedicated governance experience in the Teams admin center to manage built-in agents like Channel Agent, Facilitator, and Copilot Agent separately from traditional apps. This improves admin control, policy precision, and AI governance, with rollout completed by mid-July 2026.

item.title: MC1262590: Planner tab support for Shared and Private Channels in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Microsoft Planner tabs will be available in Microsoft Teams Shared and Private channels starting late August 2026, allowing users to create or add plans within these channels. Only basic plans are supported initially, with no admin setup needed. Planner inherits channel permissions and stores data in the channel’s SharePoint.

item.title: MC1287370: Auto upgrade of shared calendars from legacy MAPI model to modern REST model
item.description: Microsoft is auto-upgrading shared calendars in Outlook and Exchange Online from the legacy MAPI model to a modern REST model, improving sync reliability and performance. The seamless, server-side rollout begins August 2026 for GCC High/DoD tenants, requires no user action, preserves permissions, and excludes events older than one year.

item.title: MC933531: Microsoft Purview | Information Protection: Auto-labeling for Microsoft Azure Storage and Azure SQL
item.description: Auto-labeling for Microsoft Azure Storage and Azure SQL has paused its GA release. It allows extending sensitivity labels to various Azure and non-M365 data sources via auto-labeling policies. Public preview was planned for July 2025. Admins can configure labeling by default; some older labeling methods will be deprecated.

item.title: MC1419797: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention - Extend Purview data security to the network layer via Entra GSA integration
item.description: Microsoft Purview extends data loss prevention to the network layer via integration with Entra Internet Access, enabling inspection and protection of sensitive data in AI interactions and cloud services. It supports policy enforcement, alerts, and auditing, with rollout from July to October 2026, affecting Purview, Entra, and Defender administrators.

item.title: MC1422063: OneDrive for Business: Improved Windows Desktop sync error messages for max path length
item.description: OneDrive for Business on Windows will improve sync error messages for file paths exceeding 520 characters, guiding users to rename or move items without stopping sync. This update, rolling out late July to mid-August 2026, reduces confusion and support tickets with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1401303: Microsoft Teams: New Events templates with "Optimize for large audience" and policy-based behavior
item.description: Microsoft Teams is adding an "Optimize for large audience" option in new Events templates to support events over 1,000 attendees with a town hall experience, respecting CsTeamsEventsPolicy settings. Rollout begins early June 2026, with no action required unless policy adjustments are needed.

item.title: MC1420901: Notebooks in the M365 Copilot App
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot app will introduce Notebooks in early August 2026, enabling users with a Copilot license to organize chats, content, and references in a persistent workspace synced with OneNote. Existing OneNote Notebooks remain unchanged, and no admin action is required.

item.title: MC1411727: Copilot Notebooks: Suggested artifacts for faster content creation
item.description: Copilot Notebooks will proactively recommend relevant Word, Excel, and PowerPoint artifacts based on notebook content and Microsoft 365 context, speeding content creation. Available by default to eligible users starting early July 2026, no admin action is needed. Future updates will add support for PDFs and Pages.

item.title: MC1413302: Discussion post previews coming to Viva Engage
item.description: Viva Engage will introduce discussion post previews by late August 2026, allowing users to review formatting and presentation before publishing. This feature is enabled by default, requires no admin action, and affects all Viva Engage users on web and Teams. Organizations should inform users and update training accordingly.

item.title: MC1419795: PowerPoint for the web: One‑click “Review Presentation” and “Visualize Slide” Copilot skills in the ribbon
item.description: PowerPoint for the web introduces one-click Copilot buttons—“Review Presentation” and “Visualize Slide”—in the ribbon to enhance presentation quality and visual storytelling. Rolling out worldwide by early July 2026, these features require Copilot licensing and image generation enabled by admins, with no additional user setup needed.

item.title: MC1434599: Power Apps - Use streamlined header and navigation for better viewing
item.description: We are announcing the release of the streamlined header and navigation experience for app shell, form pages, and view pages within the Power Apps website. This feature will reach general availability on August 15, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature includes a refreshed header and navigation experience across the app shell, form pages, and view pages. This update improves visual clarity, reduces vertical space usage, and aligns with modern Microsoft 365 design patterns. This refreshed ex...

item.title: MC1421920: Surveys agent retirement and transition to Copilot in Microsoft Forms
item.description: Microsoft is retiring the Surveys agent by August 31, 2026, transitioning users to a unified Copilot-powered experience within Microsoft Forms. Existing surveys and conversation history remain accessible, with no licensing changes or admin actions required. Users should be informed and documentation updated accordingly.

item.title: MC1392559: Microsoft Teams: Known issue affecting screen sharing on macOS
item.description: Microsoft Teams on macOS (versions earlier than Tahoe 26.4) has a known screen sharing issue causing blank screens, interruptions, or failures. In-product guidance will roll out by mid-August 2026. Users should update macOS to 26.4 or later or enable "Use Mac OS native sharing" in Teams settings.

item.title: MC1421919: Web content setting in Microsoft 365 Copilot expands across Copilot experiences and moves to Settings
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot's Web content setting moves to Settings for consistent control across Copilot and Copilot Chat in Work and Web experiences. Rolling out mid-July 2026, it offers persistent user preferences, respects admin policies, requires no action, and expands user control where web search is allowed.

item.title: RM422323: OneNote: Summary and Q&A in OneNote Mobile with Copilot (Android)
item.description: With this new Summary feature in OneNote mobile, you can create a short and fluent summary of your longer pages which will help to consume relevant information faster. With the Question and Answer at your fingertips, you can get real-time answers to your queries directly within your notes, enhancing your ability to access and utilize information quickly and effectively.

item.title: RM422324: OneNote: Summary and Q&A in OneNote Mobile with Copilot (Iphone)
item.description: With this new Summary feature in OneNote mobile, you can create a short and fluent summary of your longer pages which will help to consume relevant information faster. With the Question and Answer at your fingertips, you can get real-time answers to your queries directly within your notes, enhancing your ability to access and utilize information quickly and effectively. We inadvertently marked this item as rolling out and now have updated it to be accurate. We apologize for any inconvenience.

item.title: RM503144: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Domain exclusion for web grounding
item.description: This feature will allow admins to specify a limited set of sites to exclude from web grounding in M365 Copilot and Copilot Chat #copilotcontrolsystem

item.title: RM553220: SharePoint: Admin policy for expiring "People in your organization" links
item.description: Administrators can now set organization-wide policies to automatically expire "People in your organization" sharing links after a specified period. This helps organizations maintain tighter control over internal content sharing by ensuring links don't remain active indefinitely. Configure expiration timeframes that align with your organization's data governance requirements—whether that's 30 days, 90 days, or a custom period.

item.title: RM558681: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Enrich Defender alerts Graph API with DLP event data
item.description: Enhance current API infrastructure to provide easy and simple way for customers to export data to integrate with SIEM tools, create automated workflows and generate customizable reports. Today alert data is present in Graph API and DLP rule match event details are present in Management API. This work enriches the graph API with DLP event data to make correlation and integration easy for customers.

item.title: RM561552: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention to restrict processing external emails in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat
item.description: We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat to safeguard risks from external emails. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Chat from processing emails from senders external to your organization.

item.title: RM561647: Microsoft Teams: Room availability signal for Teams events
item.description: In the Events app in Teams, Teams events organizers will now be able to see if the chosen room or space they have selected for their event is available at the designated time or not. This feature is available for any Teams event organizer with a Teams Enterprise license.

item.title: RM561912: Microsoft Teams: Shared & Delegate Mailbox Scheduling for Events
item.description: Empower Chiefs of Staff and delegated roles to efficiently organize events on behalf of leaders or teams using shared or delegated mailboxes. By sending trusted invites from the chosen mailbox, this capability ensures consistent identity, improved trust, and smoother event setup.

item.title: RM561915: Microsoft Teams: Save your event as template to reuse event configurations
item.description: Organizers for Teams events instances will now be able to reuse their event configurations in the Events app in Teams. Organizers can save these configurations as a template in the Events app to use again for future Teams events.

item.title: RM564606: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Declarative agents with Actions available in GCC High and DoD
item.description: Declarative Agents with Actions enable Microsoft 365 Copilot to take real-world actions by invoking APIs, plugins, and enterprise workflows directly within the chat experience. Using custom actions, declarative agents can call external systems, execute operations, and retrieve or update data, moving beyond Q&A to full task completion. These actions are powered through API plugins, MCP tools, and enterprise connectors, allowing seamless integration with line-of-business applications and services....

item.title: RM565131: Microsoft Teams: Multi-line Calling on Teams Mobile
item.description: Make and receive calls using multiple assigned phone numbers directly from your mobile device - choose the right line for every call, with unified call history and seamless switching across all your lines.

item.title: RM567889: SharePoint: Flexible Section Authoring Improvements
item.description: We've enhanced Flexible Sections in SharePoint Pages to make page layout creation more intuitive and predictable. Authors can now use visual column layout guides that mirror familiar sections, keep gridlines and layout guides visible while editing, and convert existing sections into Flexible Sections with a single click while preserving content placement. These improvements help authors create richer page designs with greater confidence and consistency across desktop, mobile, and email experienc...

item.title: RM567891: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Power BI integration in M365 Copilot
item.description: This release enables M365 Copilot to reason over Power BI enterprise data and returns grounded answers directly from Power BI reports and semantic models. Users can ask natural‑language questions and receive accurate answers.

item.title: RM567894: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Share Autonomous Agents to End Users (Run-Only)
item.description: Previously, autonomous agents could only be used and managed by makers, limiting their reach to the people who needed them. Run-only sharing enables makers to securely share autonomous agents with end users, allowing users to benefit from agent-driven automation without requiring edit permissions or ownership. This extends autonomous agent capabilities to a broader audience while maintaining governance and control.

item.title: RM567895: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Android)
item.description: Multimodal capture enables users to transcribe audio, take images, and type notes in a single session. Copilot then creates a structured Copilot Page with insights and user-captured content, saved to a user-selected Copilot Notebook. Designed for capturing offline work moments—including in-person conversations, whiteboard sessions, and personal notes. This capability is already generally available on OneNote for iPhone and iPad.

item.title: MC1419798: Microsoft Teams Rooms: Identify in-room participants with IntelliFrame people labels
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will introduce IntelliFrame people labels to identify in-room participants by name and show contact cards for remote attendees, enhancing hybrid meetings. The feature rolls out worldwide in September 2026, requires Teams Rooms Pro licenses, and uses enrolled voice and face recognition, enabling automatic labeling with admin controls.

item.title: MC1434583: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Configure organization policy link for blocked Copilot Chat users
item.description: Starting July 2026, Microsoft 365 Copilot will let admins add a custom policy link for users blocked from Copilot Chat, providing organization-specific guidance. This feature is optional, configurable via the admin center, and does not change existing access policies. No action is required.

item.title: MC1434581: Use OneDrive-stored user-defined custom skills in PowerPoint Copilot (Mac)
item.description: PowerPoint Copilot for Mac will support personal custom skills stored in OneDrive, appearing automatically in the Copilot Skills menu. Users can upload skill folders with a SKILL.md file, manage skills individually, and enable or disable them. Rollout begins late July 2026 with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1434580: Use OneDrive stored user defined custom skills in PowerPoint Copilot (web)
item.description: PowerPoint Copilot on the web will support personal custom skills stored in OneDrive, appearing in the Copilot Skills menu. Users can upload skill folders with a SKILL.md file, enable/disable skills via a new Manage Skills pane. Rollout begins late July 2026, requiring no admin action.

item.title: MC1400824: Microsoft Entra: Self-service password reset CAPTCHA protection updated
item.description: Microsoft Entra is replacing legacy CAPTCHA in self-service password reset with backend throttling and behavior-based abuse detection to enhance security and accessibility. The rollout starts early August 2026, requires no user or admin action, and maintains current password reset functionality without introducing new controls.

item.title: MC1325441: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Archive OneDrive and SharePoint files under retention
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management will add an Archive option to retention policies, allowing admins to move inactive OneDrive and SharePoint files to Microsoft 365 Archive. Archived content remains compliant and discoverable but is excluded from Copilot indexing. Rollout begins mid-August 2026, requiring admin configuration.

item.title: MC1411435: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Domain exclusion for web grounding
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot now offers Domain Exclusion, allowing admins to exclude up to 1,000 domains from web grounding to ensure responses align with organizational policies. Available worldwide from mid-July 2026, this feature requires admin configuration and affects Copilot web grounding scenarios.

item.title: MC1269210: Classic Outlook: Retirement of people card expanded view
item.description: The retirement of the people card expanded view in Classic Outlook is paused. When implemented, only the standard contact card will be available, removing features like local time and "works with." Users needing those features should use Outlook on the web or New Outlook. No admin action is required.

item.title: MC1221452: (Update)Microsoft Entra ID: General Availability of passkey profiles and migration for existing Passkeys (FIDO2) tenants
item.description: Starting March 2026, Microsoft Entra ID will GA passkey profiles and synced passkeys for tenants with Passkeys (FIDO2) enabled. Existing configurations migrate to a Default passkey profile with a new passkeyType property. Automatic migration and registration campaign updates roll out regionally through October 2026.

item.title: MC1282568: General Availability: Microsoft Entra passkeys on Windows
item.description: Microsoft Entra passkeys on Windows will be generally available from late April 2026, enabling phishing-resistant, passwordless sign-in on Windows devices without explicit opt-in. This supports corporate, personal, and shared devices, with admin controls via Authentication Methods policies and Conditional Access. No action is needed unless blocking is desired.

item.title: MC1307979: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Copilot chat pane and Summary feature in OneNote Mobile (iPhone)
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) will add a Copilot chat pane with a Summary feature in OneNote Mobile on iPhone, enabling users to generate summaries and ask questions about notes. Rollout starts mid-August 2026, with existing Copilot policies applying; no admin action is required before rollout.

item.title: MC1426708: End of support for OneDrive sync app on Windows 10 21H2 and earlier
item.description: Microsoft will end OneDrive sync app updates on Windows 10 version 21H2 and earlier starting August 15, 2026. Devices on 22H2 or later will continue receiving updates through October 10, 2028. Organizations should upgrade affected devices and inform users that OneDrive web access remains available.

item.title: MC1183010: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Q&A in Read Aloud enables real-time voice interactions
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot's Read Aloud now supports real-time voice Q&A for en-US users starting February 2026, enhancing accessibility and comprehension. This interactive feature requires a Copilot license, is enabled by default, and allows users to toggle between classic and new experiences without admin changes.

item.title: MC1243549: Retirement of SharePoint One-Time Passcode (SPO OTP) and transition to Microsoft Entra B2B
item.description: SharePoint One-Time Passcode (SPO OTP) authentication retires in October 2026, transitioning external sharing and authentication to Microsoft Entra B2B. New external sharing uses Entra B2B from May 2026. External users need guest accounts for access; admins should prepare by updating policies and managing guest accounts accordingly.

item.title: MC1301714: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention- DLP to restrict processing external emails in M365 Copilot and Copilot Chat
item.description: Microsoft Purview is adding a new DLP policy control to restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from processing emails from external or untrusted domains. This feature, off by default, will roll out from June 2026 (preview) to early 2027 (general availability) and requires admin configuration.

item.title: RM503553: Microsoft 365 Admin Center: Authoritative content management for Microsoft 365 Copilot Search
item.description: Specify and manage SharePoint sites deemed as authoritative content to enhance their relevance and ranking in Microsoft 365 Copilot Search. In the Microsoft 365 admin center, under Copilot > Search > Authoritative content, add and manage up to 100 SharePoint sites. #copilotcontrolsystem

item.title: RM522096: Microsoft Purview: Integration with Entra GSA Internet Access to enable sensitive file filtering at the network layer
item.description: Extend Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies to filter sensitive files at the network layer by integrating with Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access. This integration enables organizations to intercept and inspect files at the network layer and enforce restrictive actions based on DLP policy conditions. item.title: RM547834: Microsoft Teams: Events in Meet app in Teams
item.description: Users can now use the Teams Meet app to discover events across their organization, track what important events are upcoming, and plan and organize their own professional events.

item.title: RM557255: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention to prevent Microsoft 365 Copilot processing content with sensitivity labels supports all storage locations
item.description: The Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention policy to restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot processing sensitive files in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint will now apply regardless of file storage location.

item.title: RM557970: Microsoft Teams: Centralized notification settings for channels
item.description: Centralized notification settings streamline channel notification setup and management. Available in Teams settings, users have a single place to review and adjust notifications for all visible channels, instead of managing each individually.

item.title: RM560320: Microsoft Teams: Breakout rooms up to 1,000 Attendees in Teams meetings
item.description: Organizers can now use breakout rooms in Teams meetings with up to 1,000 attendees, enabling more interactive sessions, smaller group discussions, and improved audience engagement without compromising scale or performance.

item.title: RM567304: Microsoft Teams: Explicit recording and transcription consent for PSTN participants now available in GCC High and DoD
item.description: We are introducing explicit recording and transcription consent support for PSTN participants joining Microsoft Teams meetings in GCC High and DoD environments. item.title: RM567670: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Agent 365 agents within Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Declarative Agents
item.description: Agents that are published to Agents 365 are already managed in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. If the agent implements the Agent2Agent protocol, it can be used as a connected agent for the agents that users build in Agent Builder or Copilot Studio.

item.title: RM567884: Microsoft Teams: External phone call routing (GCC High, DoD)
item.description: External call routing will provide users the ability to redirect all external phone calls to either voicemail or their unanswered settings.

item.title: RM567888: Outlook: All Day events to show up more clearly in the Mail module Calendar Preview
item.description: We're making it easier to tell when receiving meeting invites that conflict with scheduled Out of Office time or Busy All Day events, on Outlook Web and Outlook for Windows.

item.title: RM567893: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent 365 dashboard for managers
item.description: Managers in organizations can now access their Agent 365 data through the Agent Dashboard in Copilot Analytics (Insights), enabling them to understand activity across all agents registered through Agent 365. Customers with Agent 365 and Copilot will now see the Agent 365 Dashboard with the ability to view historical data in Agent Dashboard.

item.title: MC1431377: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: AIR Investigation Experience Improvements
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365's AIR experience will add a manual refresh button, replacing auto-refresh, and simplify investigation names by removing email subjects and UPNs. These changes improve performance, reduce network activity, and support data minimization. No admin action is required, but SOC workflows and documentation should be updated.

item.title: MC1431365: Copilot Analytics - Agent 365 dashboard for managers
item.description: Managers with team-level access to Microsoft Copilot Analytics in Viva Insights will gain visibility into Agent 365 adoption and usage across their teams via the Agent 365 Dashboard. This rollout begins in late August 2026, allowing managers to monitor agent activity within their access scope and manage feature access through VFAM controls.

item.title: MC1181769: Microsoft Purview: Integration with Entra GSA Internet Access to enable sensitive file filtering at the network layer
item.description: Microsoft Purview DLP will integrate with Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access to filter sensitive files at the network layer. Public preview starts mid-November 2025; general availability by September 2026. Admins can create granular policies to prevent data leaks to unmanaged cloud apps, managed via Purview and Defender.

item.title: MC1430536: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Unified alert queue
item.description: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management is unifying classic alerts and AI-assisted triage into a single alert queue, integrating agent insights directly into the investigation workflow. This improves efficiency, retires Alert Spotlight, and maintains privacy controls. Both experiences remain available for 60 days during transition, with rollout completing by mid-October 2026.

item.title: MC1430543: Microsoft Excel: Summarize text columns and generate categories with Copilot
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot in Excel will automatically analyze unstructured text columns to generate categories and tags, aiding data analysis like survey responses. Rolling out worldwide mid to late July 2026, it requires no setup, affects licensed users, and maintains existing data compliance and controls.

item.title: MC1430542: Microsoft Outlook: Collaborate with Copilot while drafting email
item.description: Microsoft Outlook will integrate Microsoft 365 Copilot into the email compose experience by mid-July 2026, enabling licensed users to create and edit emails with AI assistance in real time across multiple platforms. The feature is enabled by default, requires no admin changes, and maintains existing policies.

item.title: MC1430540: Find your group sites faster with the new My Sites tab in OneDrive for iOS
item.description: OneDrive for iOS will add a new My Sites tab by mid-July 2026, showing all group-connected SharePoint sites users own or belong to. This enables easier access to team content without searching or recent activity, with no admin action or permission changes required.

item.title: MC1430537: Copilot in Excel: Brand Kit skill
item.description: Copilot in Excel introduces a Brand kit skill that applies organizational branding from Microsoft 365 Brand Center to workbook tables and charts, ensuring consistent, professional reports. Rolling out worldwide from mid-July to mid-August 2026, it requires no action and enhances presentation without altering data.

item.title: MC1430534: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Expanding note capabilities across alerts and cases
item.description: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management is enhancing alerts and cases with note-taking capabilities for better investigator collaboration and auditability. Users can add notes, and system-generated notes will track investigation events. Expanded user details and integrated Entra ID profiles improve context. Rollout begins late June 2026.

item.title: MC1430531: Microsoft Outlook: Meeting Insight is retiring
item.description: Microsoft is retiring Outlook's Meeting Insights by early September 2026, replacing it with Microsoft 365 Copilot's meeting preparation features for licensed users. Meeting Insights will be removed across platforms, with no action required but recommended communication, documentation updates, and user training. No compliance issues noted.

item.title: MC1430530: Microsoft OneDrive: Exclude specific folders from syncing
item.description: Microsoft OneDrive will allow administrators to exclude specific folders (e.g., node_modules, PowerShell modules) from syncing, keeping them local to devices. This feature, off by default, rolls out worldwide in August 2026, improves storage efficiency, and is managed via Group Policy with no user control over exclusions.

item.title: MC1430529: Teams frontline mobile onboarding guide retirement
item.description: Microsoft is retiring the Frontline Teams Personal Device Onboarding Wizard by late August 2026. Frontline workers will use existing Microsoft Teams, Entra ID, Intune, and Authenticator onboarding methods. No changes to security controls are needed. Organizations should update documentation and training accordingly.

item.title: MC1430523: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced file filtering in channel Shared tabs
item.description: Microsoft Teams now offers enhanced file filtering in the channel Shared tab, allowing users to filter files by type and media content in both All Documents and In Messages views. This update improves file discovery without requiring admin action and is available worldwide.

item.title: RM476488: Microsoft Teams: Ability to separate out the Townhall attendee invites
item.description: This backend change will now address the 'separation of attendee' invites from the events crew. This feature allows the organizers of Townhalls to maintain separate invites for attendees.

item.title: RM562353: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Session and Response Sharing in M365 Copilot
item.description: Session and Response Sharing let Microsoft 365 Copilot users share Copilot chat content through a link. Session Sharing shares a full chat session, while Response Sharing shares a single Copilot response. The shared content opens as a read-only view, and recipients can continue from it in their own Copilot chat. This gives Copilot users an easier and more controlled way to share useful Copilot outputs with coworkers instead of copying and pasting. It helps teams reuse work, share context, and co...

item.title: RM565132: Microsoft Teams: Granular channel notification controls
item.description: Microsoft Teams introduces flexible presets for channel notifications, allowing you to choose between All new messages, @mentions and replies, or Mute. You can further customize alerts for unfollowed threads, tags, and channel or team mentions, as well as control banner notifications for the channel. This added flexibility enables you to set notifications to match to your work style and reduce unnecessary distractions.

item.title: RM565218: Microsoft Teams: Queues app for Microsoft Teams in GCC High and DoD
item.description: We’re excited to announce that the Queues app is now available in the GCC High and DoD clouds. This Teams-native app helps organizations manage customer engagements more efficiently by bringing advanced call queue and auto attendant capabilities directly into Teams. Queues app is a Teams Premium feature. For more information about Queues app, including licensing information, please see Manage Queues app for Microsoft Teams in your organization.

item.title: RM566695: OneDrive: Block screen capture for sensitivity-labeled PDFs in the OneDrive and SharePoint web viewer
item.description: The OneDrive and SharePoint web PDF viewer will block screen capture in Microsoft Edge when users open PDFs whose sensitivity (MIP) label without Copy (EXTRACT) permission.

item.title: RM566703: Microsoft Edge: Upgraded Copilot new tab page
item.description: Search, chat, and explore the web from one search box with Copilot-suggested actions and curated work content to help your users get things done faster on the Copilot new tab page. Users will see upgraded Copilot new tab page functionality and features.

item.title: RM567470: OneDrive: Exclude specific folders from syncing
item.description: OneDrive for Windows and Mac will let users exclude specific folders from syncing, so folders that do not belong in the cloud, such as developer tooling folders like PowerShell modules, Visual Studio configuration, and node modules, stay local on the device instead of uploading to OneDrive. Administrators can define folder exclusion rules for their organization.

item.title: MC1248393: Outlook Mobile: Follow a meeting option
item.description: Outlook Mobile will add a "Follow" RSVP option for meetings with two or more participants starting early August 2026. It prompts organizers to record meetings and send updates to followers. The feature is on by default, requires no admin action, and changes the RSVP menu layout.

item.title: MC1338816: New Outlook for Windows becomes available for GCC High and DoD
item.description: New Outlook for Windows will be available in GCC High and DoD environments starting Public Preview July 30, 2026, with general rollout from September to December 2026. It remains off by default and opt-in, allowing admins control via policies and registry keys. Migration from COM to web add-ins is recommended.

item.title: MC1426371: Microsoft Entra: Passkeys by default and retirement of Microsoft-provided SMS and voice authentication
item.description: Microsoft Entra will make passkeys the default authentication method starting September 1, 2026, retiring Microsoft-provided SMS and voice authentication by February 1, 2027. Customers must configure telecom providers for SMS/voice via the Microsoft Security Store or face disruptions. Passkeys offer stronger, phishing-resistant security at no extra cost.

item.title: MC1388719: Microsoft Teams: Granular channel notification settings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce granular channel notification presets—All new messages, Mentions and replies, and Mute—with customizable options for mentions and threads. Rollout is delayed to late 2026 across environments. The feature is enabled by default, requires no admin changes, and aims to reduce notification noise.

item.description: Microsoft Teams will send separate event invites based on participant roles (Attendee, Presenter, Co-organizer). Organizers receive emails explaining roles. Rollout starts mid-September 2026, completing by late October 2026, with no admin action needed. Users should be notified and documentation updated accordingly.

item.description: We are announcing the ability to utilize the Sales Opportunity Agent to research opportunities owned by specific Owner teams in Dynamics 365 Sales. As a seller, you will be able to see Sales Opportunity Agent research results for opportunities owned by Owner teams. item.description: We are announcing the ability to visualize desktop flows with flow chart view in Power Automate. This feature will be available in public preview on July 31, 2026. How does this affect me? Users will be able to switch between the existing linear action list and a visual flow chart view while editing desktop flows. item.description: We are announcing the ability to select the next best actions (NBA) with Customer Intent Agent In Dynamics 365 Customer Service. This feature will reach general availability on July 31, 2026. How does this affect me? This new feature allows customer service representatives (CSRs) to navigate to the Copilot pane and perform a suite of actions powered by Copilot in one click. item.description: We are announcing the ability to manage exchange rate variances in cash advance transactions in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. item.description: This introduces a new DLP rule action to trigger custom Power automate workflows when a DLP rule is violated.

item.title: RM477371: SharePoint: Microsoft 365 Archive file-level archiving
item.description: This introduces archiving at the file level for Microsoft 365 Archive.

item.title: RM534607: Microsoft Viva: Engage: Detect moderated themes in images
item.description: Engages theme moderation feature is a powerful AI tool to monitor and moderate content. With this update, images can now match to themes, just like text.

item.title: RM553594: Built‑in AI Interpreter for Calls on Teams Phone Devices
item.description: With AI Interpreter, Teams Phone Devices provide real‑time language interpretation directly within the call experience. Users can participate naturally in multilingual conversations while the device interprets spoken audio, reducing language barriers and supporting clearer communication in everyday calling scenarios.

item.title: RM558682: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Reduce policy sync status SLA on the Purview UI from 2 hours to 30 mins
item.description: Admin should be able to see the Endpoint DLP policy sync status on the Purview portal within 30 mins.

item.title: RM559110: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Find meetings based on topics and keywords
item.description: Copilot will be able to find meetings based on topics or keywords from relevant data like meeting body, chat and transcription.

item.description: Understand who is building a habit using Copilot with the new power user insights in Copilot dashboard
