item.title: RM561920: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): SharePoint list support in Agent Builder
item.description: Agent Builder now supports using a SharePoint list as a knowledge source for agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot. Makers can ground an agent in structured list data so users can ask questions and get responses based on information stored in a selected SharePoint list. For this release, each agent can reference one SharePoint list with up to 20,000 items, alongside other knowledge source types. Support for list attachments and lookup columns is not yet available.

item.title: RM562340: Microsoft Teams: Preloaded video for Teams Events and Meetings
item.description: Users can now upload videos directly into a Teams event or meeting from OneDrive from the "Manage view" options when an organizer has turned on Manage What Attendees See mode. This ensures a smoother high quality video playback with a more consistent experience for attendees.

item.title: RM563806: Outlook: Emails marked with External to be supported as Rules conditions
item.description: The External tag on an email, set by the ExternalInOutlook feature, will now be usable as a condition in Outlook Inbox Rules. This change also makes available the ability to create or modify these Rules on the new Outlook for Windows, Outlook Web, and Outlook for Mac.

item.title: RM564616: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - AI Powered Data Loss Prevention Policy Optimizer
item.description: DLP Policy Optimizer uses AI to analyze your organization’s DLP policies, rule structure, and activity signals to identify optimization opportunities that are difficult to detect manually. It highlights overlapping rules, redundant conditions, misconfigurations, and sources of excessive noise, and presents prioritized recommendations with supporting evidence and suggested actions. This enables you to reduce false positives and alert noise, improve policy precision, and simplify policy management...

item.title: RM567298: Microsoft Teams: External presenters can access production controls for Teams events
item.description: Organizations can allow external presenters to manage Teams events by granting them access to production controls. Federated (B2B) and guest users can be specified in the "Who has control of production tools" setting, enabling trusted external presenters to run events and manage what attendees see. This feature supports organizations that work with third-party event producers and vendors.

item.title: RM567457: Microsoft Teams: View and manage auto attendant shared voicemails directly in the Queues app
item.description: Calls to an Auto Attendant that are routed to voicemail will now appear directly within Queues app. This enables organizations to manage shared Auto Attendant voicemails in a centralized experience, making it easier for teams to track, triage, and respond to customer messages.

item.title: RM567458: Microsoft Teams: Multilingual recap available with translation button
item.description: After meeting recap is automatically generated in the translation language chosen during the meeting, users can continue to change the language of the meeting recap after its generated.

item.title: RM567462: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced live captions settings and right-side panel view
item.description: We are improving the live captions experience in Microsoft Teams with new viewing layouts and streamlined configuration options. Users can now view live captions in a new right-side panel, in addition to the existing options of viewing them at the top or bottom of the screen, or popping them out into a separate window.

item.title: RM567465: Microsoft Teams: Teams shared display mode and peripheral detection available for DoD environments
item.description: Shared display mode in Teams is now available in government DOD environments, enabling more seamless and private meeting hosting from your PC. Additionally, peripheral detection for bring-your-own-device spaces is available for inventory management and reporting through the Pro Management portal.

item.title: RM567467: Microsoft Teams: Expand presenter visibility in 'Manage what attendees see' for Teams events
item.description: Users will now be able to resize and expand the presenter panel in 'Manage what attendees see' options for Teams events. This feature helps make it easier to view, manage, and switch between presenters during events.

item.title: RM567667: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent 365 Dashboard in Insights
item.description: Customers can now access their Agent 365 data through the Agent Dashboard in Copilot Analytics (Insights), enabling leaders to understand activity across all agents registered through Agent 365. Customers with Agent 365 and Copilot will now see the Agent 365 Dashboard with the ability to view historical data in Agent Dashboard.

item.title: MC1429024: Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Contact Center - New "After Conversation Work" presence for representatives in wrap-up
item.description: We are introducing the "After Conversation Work" status to the presence feature in Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature enhancement will be available starting July 15, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables supervisors to clearly distinguish representatives who are performing after-conversation (wrap-up) work from those who are otherwise Busy or in Do Not Disturb using two new custom presences available in the Copilot Service admin center. Thes...

item.title: MC1429019: Microsoft SharePoint Online: Restricted access control for sites enforced across Microsoft 365 search
item.description: Restricted Access Control (RAC) for SharePoint and OneDrive sites will be enforced across Microsoft 365 search, limiting search results to content users can access. This update, rolling out in late July 2026, applies automatically to existing and new RAC-enabled sites without changing RAC configurations.

item.title: MC1429018: Microsoft Teams: AI meeting archive file generation
item.description: Microsoft Teams will generate AI meeting archive files capturing key insights to enhance Microsoft 365 Copilot and Facilitator responses while ensuring privacy. Stored in tenant-owned SharePoint, archives are enabled by default with admin controls available before rollout in August 2026. Retention is configurable, and access is restricted to meeting participants.

item.title: MC1429017: Microsoft Purview: Enhanced user profile in Insider Risk Management alerts
item.description: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management alerts will display enhanced user profiles with additional Entra attributes and risk signals within the alert workflow, improving investigation efficiency while maintaining privacy protections. The update rolls out from June to October 2026, requiring no immediate action but recommended review and communication.

item.title: MC1429012: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced delegated calling with delegate call access restrictions and join notifications
item.description: Microsoft Teams is adding call delegation enhancements: delegators can lock active calls to block delegate participation and enable warning tones notifying when delegates join or resume calls. These features improve privacy and transparency during calls, rolling out worldwide from August to September 2026. No immediate admin action needed.

item.title: MC1429010: Retirement notice: Instances policy location in Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention
item.description: Microsoft is retiring the Instances policy location in Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention on January 6, 2027. Organizations must migrate existing policies to new dedicated application locations for supported non-Microsoft apps like Google Workspace, Box, and Salesforce before this date to ensure continued enforcement and support.

item.title: MC1248389: Retirement of -Credential parameter when connecting to Exchange Online PowerShell
item.description: Microsoft will retire the -Credential parameter in Exchange Online PowerShell cmdlets starting December 2026, requiring organizations to migrate scripts to modern authentication methods like MFA, app-only, or managed identity authentication to avoid disruptions. This enhances security by eliminating legacy authentication.

item.title: MC1409303: Microsoft Edge enforces screen capture restrictions for sensitivity-labeled PDFs in OneDrive and SharePoint
item.description: Microsoft Edge will enforce screen capture restrictions on sensitivity-labeled PDFs in OneDrive and SharePoint web viewers starting August 2026, aligning with Microsoft Purview Information Protection policies. This blocks screenshots for PDFs without copy permission, affecting organizations using these labels and requiring user communication and policy review.

item.title: MC1426709: Microsoft Teams: Custom recording and transcription notifications now available for 1:1 calls
item.description: Microsoft Teams now supports custom recording and transcription notifications for 1:1 calls, extending existing meeting capabilities. This ensures consistent consent messaging across communications without new admin setup. Rollout begins August 2026 for most environments; mobile clients are not yet supported. No policy changes are required.

item.title: MC1426714: Microsoft Viva: Create and customize Power BI reports
item.description: Microsoft Viva Insights will allow eligible users to create, customize, and save supported Power BI reports, including adjusting periods, filters, visuals, and layouts. This feature, available from August to September 2026, maintains existing security controls and can be managed via Viva Feature Access Management.

item.title: MC1428573: Power Automate - Automate PowerPoint presentations in desktop flows
item.description: We are announcing the ability to automate PowerPoint presentations in desktop flows in Power Automate. This feature will be available in public preview on July 31, 2026. How does this affect me? With this feature, users will be able to use Power Automate for desktop actions to interact with PowerPoint files directly within desktop flows. item.title: MC1422074: OpenAI models will soon be available as a subprocessor in Microsoft 365 Copilot
item.description: OpenAI models, including GPT-5.6, will be available as a subprocessor in Microsoft 365 Copilot starting July 9, 2026, initially disabled by default and auto-enabled on July 24, 2026, unless admins opt out. This allows faster AI updates with enterprise-grade security and compliance.

item.title: MC1317834: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Faster policy sync (2 hours to 30 minutes)
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention policy sync time will improve from 2 hours to 30 minutes, enabling faster enforcement across Microsoft 365 services. The update rolls out worldwide starting end of August 2026, requires no admin action, and is enabled by default without changing existing workflows.

item.title: MC1427972: Microsoft SharePoint: Restricted content discovery enhancements for Copilot and Microsoft 365 search
item.description: Microsoft is enhancing SharePoint's Restricted Content Discovery (RCD) to prevent content from RCD-enabled sites appearing in Copilot and Microsoft 365 search, improving data control and compliance. Changes roll out worldwide in late July 2026, requiring no immediate action but recommending policy reviews and user communication.

item.title: MC1427970: Microsoft Forms automated email sender domain is changing
item.description: Microsoft Forms will change its automated email sender from maccount@microsoft.com to no-reply@forms.mail.microsoft starting mid-August 2026. Admins should update mail flow rules and safe sender lists accordingly. GCC environments get this update from early September 2026. No compliance issues identified.

item.title: RM486828: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Apply a retention policy to Microsoft Planner content
item.description: Introducing Data lifecycle management capabilities for Microsoft Planner. Compliance admins can now create a retention policy to manage content located in Microsoft Planner such as tasks for plans associated with an Microsoft 365 Group.

item.title: RM523201: Microsoft Purview: Purview Information Protection | Classifier Simulation Mode (Health Monitoring)
item.description: Microsoft Purview introduces the Classifier Simulation Mode, the first phase of the broader Classifier Health Monitoring Platform.

item.title: RM553218: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Content Explorer – Enhanced Tag (SIT, Labels) Filter at UI Layer
item.description: Introduces enhanced controls in Content Explorer’s UI, enabling scoped visibility and filtering of SIT and label data. This will help with content discoverability and governance.

item.title: RM557191: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Block External Domain/User action in DLP for SharePoint/OneDrive
item.description: Block External Domain/User action in Microsoft Purview DLP for SharePoint and OneDrive, gives organizations stronger control over who can access sensitive files. With this enhancement, admins can configure DLP policies that block file access for specific external domains or individual users. This capability helps prevent unintended exposure by external users and supports enterprise compliance requirements.

item.title: RM558859: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Power Automate integration with records management
item.description: Initiate a Power Automate workflow when the item reaches the end of its retention period. For example, execute a complex disposition approval process or move the file to an archive.

item.title: RM558935: Microsoft Viva: New Post Creation Experience in Viva Enage
item.description: In Viva Engage, we've simplified how to create posts. The new post creation experience makes it easier and faster to share in Viva Engage with a cleaner, more intuitive publishing experience. It brings clearer layout, better accessibility, and smarter organization of tools—so you can focus on creating great posts without extra clicks or clutter.

item.title: RM560057: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention: Add control to include or exclude Default file paths exclusions for Windows
item.description: Previously customers would have system files either included or excluded manually configured. With this feature there is now a capability to provide this by default and have the option of including or excluding those paths. This list is managed by Microsoft to ensure accuracy and ease of management.

item.title: RM560398: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Add support of hyperlinks in warn & block toast messages for Edge browser
item.description: With this feature, data officers can now complete their coverage story by now embedding hyperlinks within toast messages for the Edge browser. When this rule is triggered, the end user will see a toast with a customized title and message with a hyperlink. This feature is useful when organizations need to direct users to a specific resource or a repository for more specific instruction (e.g. internal policy SharePoint site).

item.title: RM560547: Microsoft Teams: Report external users for security concerns in Teams
item.description: Users can now report suspicious external users directly within Teams, alongside existing block actions. Reports are surfaced in the Teams admin center, giving admins visibility into potentially risky interactions and enabling them to investigate and take appropriate actions. This enhancement helps organizations respond faster to phishing, impersonation, and other external threats while leveraging end-user signals as an additional layer of protection.

item.title: RM560595: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Copilot assisted commenting in Glint survey taking
item.description: Viva Glint survey takers will be able to use a streamlined version of Microsoft Copilot in the Glint survey taking experience to help them rewrite their comments, helping survey takers feel more confident about the feedback they’re providing. By increasing perceived security through reducing identifiable writing patterns and minimizing the effort required to refine feedback, this experience can encourage greater participation, longer responses, and more candid comments, which can drive higher en...

item.title: RM561209: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Insights and policy recommendations on Microsoft Copilot and AI Apps interactions for better Data Security and Compliance posture
item.description: Provide insights on Copilots and AI Apps usage and recommend retention policies for customers to govern their Copilots and AI App interactions.

item.title: RM561489: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – Introducing OCR support
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Security Investigations (DSI) is extending our investigations by adding optical character recognition (OCR), extracting text from images and incorporating it into investigation data. This enables AI-powered deep content analysis to uncover data security risks that are often hidden within visual content.

item.title: RM562343: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Insights and policy recommendations on sensitive M365 data for better Data Security and Compliance posture
item.description: Insights on sensitive M365 data (OneDrive and SharePoint) and recommendations on retention policies for customers to better govern their sensitive data.

item.title: RM564614: Microsoft Teams: Meeting recap app
item.description: The meeting recap app brings all your meeting recaps into one place, making it easier to find, filter, and catch up. Quick filters help you surface the right meetings instantly, while audio recap lets you efficiently review multiple meetings at once. You can also browse and revisit any recap from the past 30 days.

item.title: RM567300: Microsoft Teams: Prevent presence transition to "Do not disturb" setting when screen sharing (GCC High, DoD)
item.description: We're introducing a setting that allows users to opt-out of transitioning presence automatically to Do Not Disturb when presenting or screen sharing. This ensures that they can continue to receive calls, keeping them connected and responsive without manual presence adjustments.

item.title: RM567668: SharePoint: Personal Skills in Copilot in SharePoint
item.description: Create your own personal skills in Copilot in SharePoint and use them anywhere you work. Personal skills travel with you across SharePoint sites and OneDrive—so a skill like document generation works everywhere without recreating it per site. You own your skills, saved as a markdown file in your OneDrive.

item.title: RM567669: SharePoint: Enterprise store plugins in Copilot in SharePoint
item.description: Copilot in SharePoint now supports plugins from your enterprise store. A plugin can bundle skills, MCP servers, and other capabilities that extend what Copilot can do. Any plugin made available to your organization, whether installed tenant-wide by an admin or added by you, works directly in Copilot in SharePoint, all governed by your M365 admin.

item.title: RM567671: Planner: Planner Agent chat in Basic Plans
item.description: Introducing built-in Planner Agent chat with natural language Q&A, smart task discovery, and in-plan task management.

item.title: MC1427962: Network best practices for Teams town halls and live events with third‑party providers
item.description: To prevent streaming issues in Teams town halls and live events, review network settings, especially if using third-party secure web gateways, proxies, or traffic inspection. Optimize policies for real-time media, validate endpoint allowlists, configure VPN split-tunnel properly, test events, and prepare support teams. Updates ongoing.

item.title: MC1413308: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management: Insights for Copilot and AI app interactions
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management will provide new AI-driven insights on Copilot and AI app usage, helping admins improve retention policies and data security. Public preview starts late August 2026, with general availability by mid-October. No immediate action is required, but admins can prepare by reviewing insights and updating governance.

item.title: MC1185445: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Purview Information Protection | Classifier Simulation Mode (Health Monitoring)
item.description: Microsoft Purview introduces Classifier Simulation Mode, allowing admins to test custom classifiers on production data before publishing. Available from late 2026, it offers health insights and monitoring in the compliance portal to optimize classifier performance and reduce false positives, with optional simulation and automatic disabling of inefficient classifiers.

item.title: MC1324280: Assign open shifts in Microsoft Teams Shifts
item.description: Microsoft Teams Shifts introduces "Assign open shifts," enabling managers to auto-assign open shifts based on availability, time off, and scheduling rules. Rolling out worldwide from mid-June to end of July 2026, the feature is optional, reviewable before publishing, and controlled by existing scheduling permissions.

item.title: MC1324282: Support for disabling file previews in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a user-level setting to disable file previews, enabled by default. Rollout starts early June 2026, completing by July end. No admin action is needed; users can toggle previews per client under Settings > Files and links. Storage and permissions remain unchanged.

item.title: MC1324286: Microsoft Teams: Profanity filter disabled by default for live captions
item.description: Microsoft Teams will disable the profanity filter by default for live captions starting mid-June 2026, improving caption accuracy and accessibility. Users can enable or disable the filter anytime. No admin action is required, but informing support teams and users is recommended. Existing user settings remain unchanged.

item.title: MC1274550: Microsoft Teams: Quick access to read items while using unread only mode
item.description: Microsoft Teams will roll out by July 2026 a feature allowing users in unread only mode to quickly access read chats via an eye icon, improving navigation without changing filters. This is enabled by default, requires no admin action, and aims to enhance user experience.

item.title: MC1250273: Improved copy and paste support for @mentions and shared contacts in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams will preserve interactive @mentions, shared contacts, and supported tags during copy and paste when valid in the destination, falling back to plain text if not. This update, rolling out May to July 2026, improves message consistency without requiring admin action.

item.title: MC1257308: Microsoft Teams: Building‑level insights on the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal recommended actions page
item.description: Microsoft is adding building-level insights to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal's recommended actions page, highlighting buildings with high Teams Rooms usage and remaining BYOD rooms. Rolling out mid-June to end July 2026, this feature helps IT admins optimize room technology and improve user experience, enabled by default for eligible licenses.

item.title: MC1261595: Microsoft Teams town halls now support backup Real-Time Messaging Protocol (RTMP) streams
item.description: Microsoft Teams town halls will support a backup RTMP stream to improve live event reliability by automatically switching to a secondary stream if the primary fails. This feature, rolling out April to July 2026, requires no action and does not affect attendees. Organizers can enable it via Production tools.

item.title: MC1227087: Events in Meet app – Introducing a redesigned, unified Events experience in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams is redesigning the Meet app into a unified Events app, streamlining creation, discovery, and management of webinars, town halls, and custom events. Rollout begins late February 2026 with general availability by end of July 2026. No admin action needed; existing meetings and policies remain unchanged.

item.title: MC1197146: Express voice enrollment in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Express voice enrollment in Microsoft Teams enables quick voice profile registration for enhanced features like speaker recognition and improved transcripts. Rolling out mid-2026 for commercial tenants (excluding EDU), it is ON by default but can be managed or disabled by admins via PowerShell settings.

item.title: MC1317197: Microsoft Teams: A refreshed in-meeting experience with simpler controls and a smarter share panel
item.description: Microsoft Teams will refresh meeting controls and the share panel to simplify use, reduce accidental clicks, and improve sharing confidence. Changes include center-aligned controls, a separated Leave button, customizable controls, and a two-step share confirmation. Rollout begins late July 2026, with no tenant-level disable option.

item.title: MC1338823: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention – Block external domain or user access for SharePoint and OneDrive
item.description: Microsoft Purview DLP will enable blocking external SharePoint and OneDrive access by domain or email, enhancing data protection. Rolling out from late May to July 2026, admins can configure policies to block or allow specific external users, with block rules taking precedence. This feature requires admin setup.

item.title: MC1385583: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Power Automate integration with records management
item.description: Microsoft Purview Records Management will integrate with Power Automate starting January 2027, enabling admins to run custom workflows when retention-labeled items expire. This feature, not enabled by default, allows automated post-retention actions across Microsoft 365 services without changing existing retention settings. No immediate action required.

item.title: MC1422058: Measure Copilot sentiment in the Copilot Dashboard with Viva Pulse
item.description: Viva Pulse survey results will be integrated into the Copilot Dashboard by August 2026, providing detailed insights like open-text responses and heatmaps. This enables admins and leaders to better measure Copilot adoption and impact with enhanced reporting, enabled by default and requiring no workflow changes.

item.title: MC1282567: Create charts on pages with AI in SharePoint
item.description: SharePoint will introduce an AI-assisted Charts web part for page authors to create interactive charts using plain-language prompts. Rollout starts late May 2026, requiring a Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) license. The feature is enabled by default, with no required action for organizations.

item.title: RM160008: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention - Optical character recognition (OCR) support for endpoint
item.description: Optical character recognition (OCR) support will detect sensitive content in images and subsequently apply data loss prevention (DLP) policies to prevent exfiltration of that sensitive data on your Windows endpoint devices. This release supports key file types like JPG, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, BMP and PDF (image only PDF).

item.title: RM381750: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention for endpoints - Optical character recognition (OCR) support for embedded images in endpoint
item.description: This release will extend OCR support from standalone images (JPEG, JPG, PNG, BMP, TIFF, and PDF) to images embedded inside the following files and file types: Office files (XLSX, DOCX, PPTX), container files (zip, rar, 7z, and more), and PDF files. Image-only PDF files are already supported, and this this release will support hybrid PDF files containing images and searchable text. Updated May 20, 2026: We have paused rollout and will resume soon. Thank you for your patience.

item.title: RM494839: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Scanner data export for custom reporting
item.description: Learn about the state of your scanned repositories and create custom reports with the information protection scanner. Labeling, classification and protection actions on scanned files are stored in SQL tables that form a foundation to feed into custom reports.

item.title: RM496371: Outlook: add attachments while offline in the new Outlook for Windows
item.description: We are adding more functionality to offline mode in the new Outlook for Windows. You will now be able to add attachments while drafting your email without an internet connection. #newoutlookforwindows

item.title: RM496596: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Content Sources in Copilot Chat
item.description: Users will able to select content sources on Copilot Chat. When users select content sources the responses generated will be limited to content from the selected sources.

item.title: RM500872: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Export Copilot metrics in the Copilot Dashboard
item.description: This enables users to export row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis.

item.title: RM503563: Microsoft 365 admin center: Organizational Messages now supports Action Segments
item.description: Action Segments empowers IT Admins to target Organizational Messages using dynamic, pre-defined usage segments. This behavior-based targeting approach goes beyond existing static group definitions, ensuring messages reach the most relevant users.

item.title: RM503587: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Admins can manage access more precisely with support for nested permissions in Jira, Confluence, and ServiceNow
item.description: Support for hierarchical ACLs for SNOW, Confluence, Jira connectors.

item.title: RM512428: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot connectors are available for U.S. Department of Defense environment
item.description: Copilot connectors enable organizations to integrate content from other external data sources into Microsoft Graph, improving Copilot’s intelligence, contextual responses, and content discoverability

item.title: RM515144: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Engage private content in M365 Copilot
item.description: Engage content from private communities and events will be used as grounding source for M365 Copilot. When a user queries in M365 Copilot, they will only be able to see content they are privileged to access.

item.title: RM545013: SharePoint: Microsoft 365 Archive in GCC-L
item.description: Microsoft 365 Archive is designed to help organizations manage their inactive data efficiently. It allows you to move inactive SharePoint sites into a cold storage tier, which reduces storage costs while maintaining the same searchability, security, and compliance standards as active data. This feature is already available in Production and is now being released to GCC-L cloud.

item.title: RM545063: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management- Insider risk management for agents
item.description: As AI agents become deeply embedded in enterprise ecosystems, they are evolving beyond simple tools or workflows into a digital workforce. item.description: Sales agent gives you strong CRM-based account and opportunity summaries, but important context is often spread across non-CRM systems. With this capability, you can add insights from any application to enrich account and opportunity summaries in Sales agent, so sellers get a unified view of their accounts and deals in one place without switching applications.

item.title: RM567003: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Enrich Sales agent meeting prep with more data sources
item.description: Walking into a customer meeting with incomplete context can mean missed risks, overlooked issues, and conversations that fall flat. With access to richer data, like service tickets, directly in your meeting prep, you can spot open issues and opportunities before the conversation starts. This insight helps you engage more meaningfully, build stronger relationships, and drive better sales outcomes.

item.title: RM567004: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Link meetings to CRM records automatically with AI
item.description: This feature saves you time by automatically connecting your meetings to the correct CRM records. You have the right deal insights at your fingertips when preparing for customer conversations, so you can focus less on updating records and more on selling with confidence and context.

item.title: RM567314: Microsoft Teams: SharePoint app in Teams
item.description: When a user who has access to the SharePoint app in Teams clicks a SharePoint page or news link in Teams chat or channels, the link will open inside the SharePoint app in Teams (if available) instead of the mobile browser

item.title: MC1392563: OneDrive transitions to the cloud.microsoft domain
item.description: OneDrive is transitioning to the onedrive.cloud.microsoft domain starting late July 2026, with both old and new URLs working side by side indefinitely. There are no changes to file access or APIs, but admins should review custom solutions relying on URL patterns. No immediate action is required.

item.title: MC1183013: Microsoft Viva Engage: Flexible targeting of Storyline Announcements
item.description: Microsoft Viva Engage introduces My Team audiences and flexible targeting for Storyline Announcements, allowing leaders to tailor messages using organizational attributes, groups, or individuals. Public preview starts mid-November 2025; general availability is in November 2026. Premium licensing is required; no admin action needed for rollout.

item.title: MC1197145: Microsoft Teams: Apps now supported in Private Channels
item.description: Microsoft Teams now supports apps in Private Channels, allowing bots, tabs, and message extensions to be added per channel with new governance controls. This feature is generally available, requires developer updates for custom apps, and includes admin management and compliance considerations.

item.title: MC1420635: Dynamics 365 Contact Center – Privileges and role-based access
item.description: We are announcing the ability to use role-based access for agents and customer service representatives using Microsoft Entra ID within Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on July 24, 2026. How does this affect me? With this feature, admins can link a Microsoft Entra security group to a Dataverse team of the type Microsoft Entra ID Security Group and assign the required security roles once at the team level, such as Basic User, Customer Service Representative...

item.title: MC1420564: Dynamics 365 Sales - Enable Automatic CRM Record Linking and Suggested Updates for Accounts, Contacts, and Leads
item.description: We are announcing the ability to enable Automatic CRM Record Linking and Suggested Updates for Accounts, Contacts, and Leads in Dynamics 365 Sales. This feature will reach general availability on August 7, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables AI-powered data enrichment that helps you keep related CRM records accurate by automatically surfacing relevant insights from seller conversations. With this enhancement, you get record-level intelligence that: Detects accounts, contacts, and...

item.title: RM562662: Microsoft 365 app: New Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot App
item.description: The new Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app now lets users organize related chats, output creations, and references into a persistent AI workspace. Copilot uses the Notebook's accumulated context to ground responses, so work continues across sessions instead of starting over each time. While this is the quicker, light-weight Notebooks experience, you can still find the fuller, workspace-forward experience in OneNote.

item.title: RM567010: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - User Based Aggregation of DLP Alerts
item.description: Enable aggregation of DLP alerts based on common entities user even when multiple rules are matched. This feature should consolidate related alert events into a single alert object to: Reduce alert noise, simplify investigation workflows, enhance contextual understanding of violations.

item.title: RM486695: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Prompt Gallery - Company-wide prompt publishing
item.description: Organizations can build their own collections of prompts that are tailored to their business needs and workflows and distribute these to all users within the tenant.

item.title: RM552598: Microsoft Edge: Improvements to site permissions user interfaces
item.description: To better align with user expectations, site permissions are changing to look and work both in context on a website that is requesting permissions and when navigating to permissions from Settings. On a website that is requesting permissions, there are changes to the Omnibox and the Page Info dialog and permissions will be easier to see and modify in Settings.

item.title: RM557189: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Ability to preview content in Insider Risk Management Alerts
item.description: Insider Risk Management is excited to announce the ability to preview content directly within an IRM alert without having to create a case. Users with appropriate permissions will be able to preview relevant files referenced directly within activity explorer in each alert.

item.title: RM557681: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Intelligent Summaries in Copilot Dashboard
item.description: Use intelligent summaries in Copilot Dashboard to quickly surface what’s working and where targeted attention can accelerate Copilot adoption. Intelligent summaries highlight key adoption trends to focus on areas of success. Suggested prompts enable deeper exploration of underlying trends and drivers.

item.title: RM557975: Microsoft Teams: One-time email passcodes for external presenters in Teams events
item.description: One-time email passcodes provide an easy way for tenant administrators and event organizers to verify anonymous, external presenters invited to their events. Anonymous external presenters will be shown with a "Verified" tag once completing the process. Based on admin settings, the event organizer will also have a set of options available to them that applies to all external presenters, providing the ability to control who is admitted to the meeting or allowing uninvited users with the link to be...

item.title: RM558108: Microsoft Teams: Catch up on conversations in Microsoft Teams mobile
item.description: Catch up in Teams mobile provides a unified view of all directed and followed conversations across chats, meeting chats, channels and threads. The mobile-optimized card view supports swipe actions, helping you quickly review and triage lists of important items.

item.title: RM558684: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Sensitivity label support in Engage
item.description: Organizations can now manually apply Purview Information Protection sensitivity labels in Engage. Allowing admins to create labels and configure label publishing policies to determine which users and groups can manually label content in Engage communities. End users in Engage will be able to then manually apply labels to communities and in turn classify and protect their sensitive data via privacy and external user access controls.

item.title: RM558685: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Exclude modern groups / include dynamic security groups support for sensitivity label policies
item.description: To provide more flexibility, admins can now exclude modern Microsoft 365 groups and scope sensitivity label policies to dynamic and non-mail enabled security groups—expanding policy targeting beyond individual users and mail enabled groups.

item.title: RM558686: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Sensitivity label inheritance for Teams meeting artifacts
item.description: Teams meeting artifacts, including recordings, transcripts, and Loop notes, can now be configured to automatically inherit the sensitivity label from the meeting. This ensures content generated during meetings is consistently protected without requiring manual labeling, reducing risk and simplifying protection at scale.

item.title: RM558687: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Policy sync status for M365 Label publishing policies
item.description: Admins can now see the sync status of sensitivity label publishing policies directly in the Purview portal. This provides clear confirmation that label policy changes have been fully applied across Microsoft 365 workloads, reducing guesswork, speeding troubleshooting, and increasing confidence during large scale label deployments.

item.title: RM560399: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Microsoft Fabric, Cloud storage, cloud service activities as triggers
item.description: With this update, the indicators belonging to cloud storage apps (Box, Dropbox, Google Drive), cloud services (Azure, Amazon Web Services) and Microsoft Fabric (Power BI, Lakehouse) will be supported as triggers in Data leaks policy. With triggers, customers can define the conditions for bringing the user into the scope of a policy while the respective indicators are used to determine risk score.

item.title: RM561490: Microsoft Teams: Connect Teams meeting to existing Planner Plans
item.description: Teams meetings automatically create a corresponding Planner plan to capture meeting tasks. However, when teams use meetings as their primary collaboration surface for long-running initiatives, tasks from the same project can become scattered across multiple auto-generated plans. With this capability, users can now connect Teams meetings to existing Planner plans, so all related tasks across meetings can be tracked in one place.

item.title: RM561551: Microsoft Edge: Intune MAM Protected Downloads
item.description: The protected downloads feature for Intune MAM will now save downloaded files to the Documents > Microsoft Edge > Downloads folder in OneDrive.

item.title: RM562991: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Allow customer to scope JIT Audit to specific user or user group
item.description: Enable customers to include or exclude users/user groups from Just‑In‑Time (JIT) Audit, ensuring audits are generated only for the selected users or groups.

item.title: RM562992: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention – Ability to protect files stored in the excluded folders in Windows
item.description: Endpoint DLP now extends protection to files stored in commonly excluded Windows folders, including Temp and AppData. This helps improve coverage by detecting and protecting sensitive data in these locations.

item.title: RM562993: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention — Endpoint DLP now supports a pre curated list of file extensions for the file extension condition
item.description: Endpoint DLP now includes a pre curated list of file extensions for the file extension condition. Previously, file extensions were entered as free form text, which could result in unsupported or non-scannable extensions being used. This could lead to gaps in protection and increase processing overhead on endpoints. With the pre curated list, you can select only supported file extensions. This helps improve policy reliability and reduces unnecessary processing on endpoints.

item.title: RM565863: OneNote: Copilot Notebook in OneNote on Mac
item.description: Copilot Notebook, an AI-powered workspace for a project or topic built on reference materials, is coming to OneNote on Mac. Bring together your work context behind a project in one place.

item.title: RM566859: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Use SharePoint lists as a knowledge source
item.description: Unlock the full value of your structured data by bringing SharePoint lists directly into your Microsoft Copilot Studio agents. With native support, customers can ground AI responses in up-to-date, business-critical data—such as tasks, inventory, customers, or operations—without manual data movement or complex integrations. This enables more accurate, context-aware copilots that reflect how your business runs, helping teams make faster decisions, reduce errors, and automate workflows with confide...

item.title: RM567318: Outlook: Reply with a Template in Rules
item.description: You can now create a rule that automatically replies to incoming messages with a template you've set up. Set the conditions you care about and pick the template, and Outlook handles the response for you. It's a simple way to send consistent replies without typing the same thing over and over. #newoutlookforwindows

item.title: RM567319: Outlook: Categorize Emails by Dragging Them onto a Favorite Category
item.description: You can now add a category to your Favorites and then drag emails right onto it to apply that category. No need to open menus or right-click each message. Just pin the category you use most to Favorites, then drop your emails on it to tag them in one quick motion. It's a faster, more visual way to keep your inbox sorted the way you like. #newoutlookforwindows

item.title: MC1419802: Microsoft Teams: New layout for sharing content in Teams events
item.description: Microsoft Teams is introducing a new Speaker focused layout for Teams events, prioritizing presenter video alongside shared content to enhance engagement. This update, enabled by default, rolls out globally from August to September 2026 for Teams Enterprise users, with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1419801: Microsoft Viva Insights: Is Active filter no longer applied by default in new Advanced Insights queries
item.description: Starting August 2026, Microsoft Viva Insights Advanced Insights will no longer apply the Is Active filter by default in new Custom Query – Person queries. Analysts must select it explicitly. Copilot-only queries disable this filter. Existing queries remain unchanged but users should migrate to new templates.

item.title: MC1419800: SharePoint button web part: Add custom Copilot in SharePoint prompts or start Power Automate flows
item.description: The SharePoint Button web part will support launching custom Copilot prompts or Power Automate flows, enhancing productivity and automation. Available from late July 2026, it affects SharePoint page owners, Copilot-licensed users, and flow-authorized users, with no admin action required. Existing buttons remain unchanged.

item.title: MC1419799: Configurable recovery window for Microsoft 365 Backup
item.description: Microsoft 365 Backup now allows admins to configure recovery windows from 3 months to 2 years, replacing the fixed 1-year default. This enhances flexibility for compliance and cost management. The feature rolls out worldwide in late July 2026, requires manual configuration, and may permanently delete data outside the set window after a grace period.

item.title: MC1266912: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Intelligent Summaries in Copilot Dashboard
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Dashboard will add AI-generated intelligent summaries by mid-August 2026, highlighting adoption trends and usage insights for admins. The feature is on by default, requires no configuration, and includes suggested prompts. No user impact or compliance issues are expected.

item.title: MC1293480: Exchange Online: Retirement of legacy TLS versions for POP and IMAP connections
item.description: Exchange Online will retire legacy TLS versions (1.0 and 1.1) for POP3 and IMAP4 connections from August 1 to December 31, 2026. Connections must use TLS 1.2 or later; older versions will fail. Organizations should ensure all email clients and applications support TLS 1.2+ and update legacy systems accordingly.

item.title: MC1279093: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Enhancing how we handle promotional mail
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will tag promotional emails as “promotions” and can auto-move them to a Promotions folder, learning from user actions. Public preview starts mid-April 2026; general availability begins late July 2026. Admins control settings; users can train the system by moving messages.

item.title: MC1384420: Microsoft Purview | Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Ability to protect files stored in the excluded folders in Windows
item.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP will protect sensitive files in previously excluded Windows folders like AppData during egress actions starting mid-September 2026. Admins must update anti-malware, review excluded paths, extend policies, and educate users. Audit mode logs actions; block mode enforces restrictions.

item.title: MC1384415: Microsoft Purview | Endpoint Data Loss Prevention now supports a pre‑curated file extension list
item.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP now uses a pre-curated list of supported, scannable file extensions for policy configuration, improving accuracy and enforcement consistency. Free-form entry is removed; unsupported extensions must be managed via a specific feature. Rollout begins mid-September 2026, with no change to existing protections unless policies are edited.

item.title: MC1387575: Microsoft Purview | Endpoint Data Loss Prevention: Scope Just-in-time audit by user or group
item.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint Data Loss Prevention now requires admins to explicitly configure which users or groups are audited under Just-in-time protection, enhancing control and reducing unnecessary audit noise. The rollout begins mid-September 2026, with updated settings to manage audit scope and activity logging in Activity explorer.

item.title: MC1330888: Upcoming change to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint Advanced Hunting: removal of SMB signature data
item.description: Starting July 13, 2026, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint will remove SMB signature inspection events from Advanced Hunting to improve performance. Queries using these events will stop working; users should update them to filter SMB traffic by port 445 in DeviceNetworkEvents before July 1, 2026.

item.title: MC1409042: Microsoft OneNote: Copilot notebook available in OneNote on Mac
item.description: Microsoft is rolling out Copilot Notebook, an AI-powered workspace in OneNote for Mac, starting early August 2026. It requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, is enabled by default without admin controls, and helps users organize and analyze notes using generative AI. No action is required from admins.

item.title: MC1413298: Roadmap information for Microsoft Copilot Studio and agents transitioning to the Microsoft 365 Roadmap
item.description: Starting July 2, 2026, Microsoft Copilot Studio and agent roadmap updates will move from Release Planner to the Microsoft 365 Roadmap for unified tracking. Release Planner links will redirect automatically, but some custom planning features will be discontinued. No immediate action is required.

item.title: MC1317195: Microsoft Copilot Notebooks: Introducing Infographics
item.description: Microsoft Copilot Notebooks introduces Infographics, enabling users to create visual summaries from notebook content with grounded references. Public preview starts late May 2026, general availability in early July 2026. The feature is enabled by default, respects existing policies, requires no action, and enhances communication without disrupting workflows.

item.title: MC1217640: Microsoft Purview | Information Protection - Content Explorer: Unscanned data and Classification History summary metrics
item.description: Microsoft Purview Content Explorer will add summary metrics showing unscanned files and classification history trends, helping admins monitor data classification. The feature rolls out from July to November 2026, is enabled by default, requires no action, and does not change existing data processing.

item.title: MC1266027: Microsoft Teams: New experience when users minimize the meeting window
item.description: Microsoft Teams is updating the minimized meeting window to allow key actions like raising hands and sending reactions without reopening the full window. Users can choose between expanded or compact views. The rollout paused as of July 7, 2026, with no impact on screen sharing or admin settings.

item.title: MC1318124: Microsoft Teams: New search experience for cloud files in the file attach picker
item.description: Microsoft Teams will enable search for cloud files directly in the attach file picker, improving quick sharing in chats and channels. Rollout starts June 2026, completing by late July. Users see only files they have access to, with no changes to permissions. No action required.

item.title: MC1318125: Microsoft Teams: Quick Share for images
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a Quick Share option for images, enabling faster sharing and copying of image links within chats, channels, and shared tabs. Rollout starts June 2026, with existing permissions maintained, no new admin controls, and the feature enabled by default. No user action required.

item.title: MC1318249: New file download manager in Teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams will roll out a new file download manager starting June 2026, featuring auto-dismissing download notifications after about 4 seconds and easy access to downloaded files. The update is enabled by default, affects all users globally, and requires no action but may need helpdesk notification.

item.title: MC1316228: Keyboard shortcut dialog has search functionality
item.description: Microsoft Teams is adding search functionality to the Keyboard shortcuts dialog, enabling users to find shortcuts by action name or key combination. This feature, enabled by default, will roll out worldwide from early June to late July 2026, improving shortcut discoverability and customization without affecting existing workflows.

item.title: MC1316231: Microsoft Teams: Front-of-room view control for Webinars and structured meetings in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will default front-of-room displays to attendee view during webinars and structured meetings starting mid-June 2026, enhancing in-room participant experience. Presenters retain full control via the console. The feature requires a Teams Rooms Pro license, is enabled by default, and needs no user action.

item.title: MC1310683: Microsoft Teams: Standardized preview experience for PowerPoint, Excel, and Word files
item.description: Microsoft Teams will roll out a standardized preview experience for Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files by late July 2026, improving load times and reliability. PowerPoint and Excel previews are on iOS and Android; Word preview is iOS only. The feature is enabled by default with no admin action needed.

item.title: MC1279071: Queues app on Microsoft Teams mobile
item.description: The Queues app in Microsoft Teams mobile (iOS and Android) will allow calling representatives and supervisors to manage call queues, view queue details, and call history on the go. Rollout begins mid-May 2026, completing by end of July, enabled by default for licensed Teams Phone and Premium users.

item.title: MC1287373: Microsoft Teams introduces efficiency mode to improve app responsiveness
item.description: Microsoft Teams will roll out Efficiency Mode by late May 2026 to improve performance on hardware-constrained devices. Enabled by default, it adjusts video resolution and app behavior to enhance responsiveness. Users can opt out via settings. The rollout completes by end of July 2026.

item.title: MC1323270: Microsoft Teams: Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) support for Teams meetings and events
item.description: Microsoft Teams will support Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) for town halls and live events starting June 2026, allowing improved, low-latency streaming with automatic failover alongside existing RTMP. No user impact; admins must enable SRT in meeting policies and update event production accordingly.

item.title: MC1392571: Connect Teams meeting to existing Planner Plans
item.description: Microsoft Teams meetings can now be linked to existing Microsoft Planner plans, allowing tasks to be tracked in one place. This feature, rolling out from late August to late September 2026, supports automated or manual task creation via Facilitator and requires Teams, Planner, and Loop enabled in the tenant.

item.title: MC1134737: Microsoft Teams: Private channels increased limits and transition to group compliance
item.description: Microsoft Teams is migrating private channels to use group mailboxes, increasing limits to 1000 channels per team and 5000 members per channel, and enabling meetings in private channels. Migration runs from October 2025 to April 2026. Admins must remediate ownerless channels by July 2026 or risk deletion. Compliance policies must be updated to apply at the team group level.

item.title: MC1418558: Change to taskbar pinning behavior for M365 Copilot and companion apps
item.description: Starting mid-July 2026, Microsoft 365 admin center taskbar pinning will only manage the Microsoft 365 Copilot app, excluding companion apps (Files, Calendar, People). Existing companion app pins remain unchanged. Organizations needing companion app pinning should use Microsoft Intune policies instead. No action required if only Copilot is pinned.

item.title: RM392839: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Automatic data preservation for high-risk users
item.description: Adaptive Protection in Microsoft Purview helps you protect your organization’s data by integrating dynamic insider risk levels, determined by data related activities, with various policy engines to automatically moving users in and out of policies as their risk levels change over time. The integration with Data Lifecycle Management will automatically apply retention labels to preserve deleted emails and files based on a user’s insider risk level.

item.title: RM421612: Microsoft 365 app: Microsoft Loop - Departed user content workflows for user-owned Loop workspaces
item.description: Manage retention and deletion workflows for user-owned Loop workspaces like Copilot Pages when users leave the organization. Notify and provide temporary access to other employees or administrators to save important data before deletion policies take effect.

item.title: RM499076: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: Information Protection- Scan existing files in SharePoint and OneDrive for business for sensitive information
item.description: This new capability will enable admins to scan existing files at rest in SharePoint or OneDrive for business for sensitive data.

item.title: RM502532: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] [Search UX] Enable customization of icon & name for data sources in Search (& chat)
item.description: Enable customization of icon & name for data sources in Search (& chat).

item.title: RM518287: Outlook: LDAP directory support for S/MIME in New Outlook
item.description: The new Outlook now supports LDAP (Lightweight Directory Access Protocol) directories for sending S/MIME encrypted emails. This allows users to add an LDAP directory in the new Outlook and use it to fetch recipients’ certificates from the configured directory when sending S/MIME encrypted messages. #newoutlookforwindows

item.title: RM518288: Outlook: Support for Storing S/MIME Certificates in Contacts in New Outlook
item.description: The new Outlook will now allow users to store S/MIME encryption certificates within their Contacts. This enables users to save certificates directly in contact entries and use them to send S/MIME encrypted emails to the contacts. #newoutlookforwindows

item.title: RM528978: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management-Priority content support for Risky AI usage
item.description: With this update, Risky AI usage policy template will support priority content. Customers can define Sensitive Info Types (SITs), Trainable Classifiers, Sensitivity Labels as priority content, and get alerted only when the activity matches the selected priority content. Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers...

item.title: RM536571: Microsoft Teams: User reported security signals in Teams admin center
item.description: This update brings end user security reporting into Teams Admin Center. Admins can now view and download signals from messages users report as a security concern or not a security concern within TAC Protection reports, helping them identify trends and fine tune policies and responses.

item.title: RM547837: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - New Permissions
item.description: Adding new, more granular permissions for Viva Glint administration. These areas include Advanced Configuration, Nudges, General Settings, and Viva Integrations. Updating the name of the highest privileged role in Viva Glint to “Viva Glint Service Admin”, and for increased security, restricting the ability to assign new Viva Glint Service Admins to the MAC only.

item.title: RM548640: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Survey Designer Role
item.description: To empower organizations to run additional employee listening programs, like AI transformation or change management cases, we are creating a dedicated Survey Designer role. This role grants a user just enough permissions to run a Viva Glint survey without full access to platform settings and sensitive data, thus creating a more democratized platform.

item.title: RM554937: Microsoft 365: Change Meeting Organizer via PowerShell Cmdlet in Exchange Online
item.description: Allows the administrator of an Exchange Online tenant to change the organizer of an existing meeting or meeting series via a PowerShell cmdlet. This can be used, for example, to maintain continuity and history of a long-running meeting series in cases where the meeting organizer has a new role, is on leave, or during the offboarding process. Once the meeting is transferred, the new organizer will be able to maintain all properties of the event including meeting time and recurrence, attendees, an...

item.title: RM557184: Microsoft Teams: Context preservation in Teams
item.description: When you return to a conversation within a short duration of time, your selected tab, opened side panel, and layout are restored automatically, so you can keep working without resetting your workspace. In addition, returning to a Quick View within a short duration will restore your previously selected message.

item.title: RM557982: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Custom confidentiality statements
item.description: This feature enables Company Admins to customize the default Microsoft Viva Glint confidentiality statement. Admins can choose to turn off the default statement and instead define confidentiality messaging tailored to their specific program settings, such as whether responses are configured to be confidential.

item.title: RM562534: Microsoft Teams: Front-of-room view control for Town Hall in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: When a Teams Rooms on Android is invited as a meeting presenter, the front-of-room display defaults to the attendee view. Presenters always have full control from the console, including green room and off-stage management, and can switch the front-of-room display to presenter view without impacting attendees. Available in Teams Rooms Pro.

item.title: RM564610: Outlook: Variable number of message preview lines
item.description: Outlook for Windows and Outlook for Web will now allow users to modify how the preview text for emails show in the message list. The preview text can now take up 2 lines, 1 whole line, or 0 additional lines.

item.title: RM565220: Microsoft Teams: Open message links in new window
item.description: Teams now enables links within chat and channel messages to open in a new window, so you can compare information side by side without losing the context of your ongoing conversation. Access this capability through the More options menu or by using Ctrl/Cmd + click.

item.title: RM565860: Microsoft Edge: Sign in to Edge with a Google account
item.description: Users can now sign in to Microsoft Edge using a Google account in addition to the Microsoft account from the profile menu and Edge sign-in screen. Available for Windows and macOS devices. Admins can control availability to this feature using the NonMicrosoftAccountSignInEnabled policy.
